de.title: HR Mitarbeiter/in 40%
de.description:
Senevita ist die grösste integrierte Anbieterin von Dienstleistungen im Alter und beschäftigt rund 4'000 Mitarbeitende. Ambulante und stationäre Angebote gehen nahtlos ineinander über. Während die Senevita Standorte für selbstständiges betreutes Wohnen und umfassende Pflege stehen, ist Senevita Casa die schweizweit führende Anbieterin privater Spitex-Leistungen.
Im Januar 2026 eröffnet die Senevita Birsgarten in Reinach /BL. Wir bieten insgesamt 88 Pflegeplätze (22 geschützte Abteilung), 52 Wohnungen für betreutes Wohnen und ein Restaurant in idyllischer Lage mit sehr guter ÖV Anbindung. Zur Ergänzung des Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine motivierte und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit als
HR-Mitarbeitende 40%
Gestalte unseren neuen Betrieb aktiv mit.
Du trägst du massgeblich dazu bei, die Prozesse einzuführen um die Dienstleistungen und Qualität auf höchstem Niveau zu etablieren. Dich erwartet ein neues und modernes Arbeitsumfeld, sowie die Chance, dein Team und das Zuhause für unsere Bewohnenden nachhaltig zu prägen und mitzugestalten.
Deine Aufgaben

• Führung der HR- Prozesse (Rekrutierung, Personalsupport, Mitarbeiterbetreuung-/administration, Lohnadministration, Stammdatenpflege, etc.)

• Aktive Zusammenarbeit mit der HR-Abteilung des Hauptsitzes

• Unterstützung und Beratung der Bereichs-/ Abteilungsleitungen

• Führung Zeiterfassungssystem, Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse (PEP)

• An- und Abmeldungen bei Ämtern und Sozialversicherungspartnern

• Prozessverantwortung Absenzen-Management

• Bereitstellen von Auswertungen, Kennzahlen und Statistiken
Wir erwarten

• Grundausbildung als Kaufmann/-frau EFZ mit Weiterbildung im Personalbereich (Personalassistent/in, Personalsachbearbeitende, o.ä.)

• Mehrjährige Berufspraxis in vergleichbarer Funktion (Vorteilhaft im Gesundheitswesen)

• Strukturierte und exakte und effiziente Arbeitsweise

• Fähigkeit zum ganzheitlichen und vernetzten Denken

• Sehr versiert mit Office-Anwendungen (ideal auch in PEP, Rexx)

• Hohe Sozialkompetenz und Dienstleistungsbereitschaft

• Ausgezeichnete Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch (mündlich und schriftlich)

• Ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten

• Flexibilität zur Überbrückung bei Ferienabwesenheiten
Was wir dir bieten

• Neueröffnung in einem modernen Haus und Arbeitsumgebung mit ÖV Anbindung

• Umfangreiche Arbeitsinstrumente (Konzepte, Prozessanleitungen, etc.)

• Neue und moderne Infrastruktur (Gebäude, IT, etc.)

• Ein abwechslungsreiches und verantwortungsvolles Aufgabenfeld

• Eine wertschätzende Führungskultur und interne Weiterbildungen

• Umfangreiches Weiterbildungsangebot

• Attraktive Vergünstigungen/ Partner-Rabatte/ Benefits (Verpflegung, Job-Ticket/UAbo, Zusatzversicherungen, etc.)

• Gute Sozialleistungen und mind. 5 Wochen Ferien (ab 50 Jahren 6 Wochen bzw. ab 60 Jahren 7 Wochen Ferien)

Nutze die Chance, neues zu gestalten mit uns!
Wir freuen uns dich kennenzulernen! Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft und bieten unseren Bewohnenden und Mitarbeitenden hochstehende Dienstleistungen.
Sende uns deine Online Bewerbung.
Wende dich bei Fragen bitte per Mail an:
Christian.schuepbach@senevita.ch

• Bereitstellen von Auswertungen, Kennzahlen und Statistiken

Anforderungen

• Flexibilität zur Überbrückung bei Ferienabwesenheiten

Wir bieten

it.description:
Sene Vita è il più grande fornitore integrato di servizi di vecchiaia e impiega circa 4.000 persone. I servizi ambulatoriali e fissi sono perfettamente integrati. Mentre Sene Vita sono per le sedi indipendenti curate per la vita e l'assistenza completa, Sene Vita Casa è il fornitore leader di servizi privati Spitex in tutta la Svizzera. Nel gennaio 2026, Sene Vita Birsgarten apre a Reinach /BL. Offriamo un totale di 88 posti di cura (22 reparto protetto), 52 appartamenti per la vita curata e un ristorante in una posizione idillica con ottimi collegamenti con i trasporti pubblici.

Per completare il team, ora stiamo cercando attivamente una personalità motivata e orientata al team come dipendenti HR 40% della nostra nuova azienda. Stai contribuendo così a introdurre i processi per stabilire il massimo livello di servizi e qualità. Un ambiente di lavoro nuovo e moderno vi aspetta, così come l'opportunità di modellare e modellare il vostro team e la casa per i nostri residenti in modo sostenibile.

In January 2026, Sene Vita Birsgarten opens in Reinach /BL. We offer a total of 88 care places (22 protected department), 52 apartments for cared living and a restaurant in an idyllic location with very good public transport connections.

To complement the team, we are now actively looking for a motivated and team-oriented personality as HR employees 40% of our new company. A new and modern working environment awaits you, as well as the opportunity to shape and shape your team and home for our residents in a sustainable way.

En janvier 2026, Sene Vita Birsgarten ouvre à Reinach /BL. Nous offrons un total de 88 places de soins (22 services protégés), 52 appartements pour la vie de personnes et un restaurant dans un emplacement idyllique avec de très bonnes connexions de transport public.

Wir suchen einen Handelsüberwachungsanalysten als Einzelmitarbeiter mit Erfahrung in den folgenden Bereichen: Mansioni – Durchführung automatisierter und manueller Marktverhaltensüberwachungsaktivitäten in der gesamten Investment Bank- und Wealth Management-Abteilung. - Analyse von Fällen potenziell verdächtiger Aktivitäten, die von unseren Systemen gemeldet werden. - Kontaktaufnahme mit Geschäftsinteressenten zu Eskalationen im Zusammenhang mit dem Marktverhalten und anderen Angelegenheiten. - Vorantreiben kontinuierlicher Prozessverbesserungen und Mitwirken an strategischen Projekten und Automatisierungs-/Optimierungsinitiativen. - Durchführung einer Überwachung des Handels mit Informationsbarrieren für den Privatkundenhandel (PAD) von Unternehmen, Kunden und Mitarbeitern. fr.title: Analyste des opérations de surveillance commerciale
fr.description: Ragionamento suite 1. Identification de la section - Le test commence avec une série de domaines introductifs et une phrase qui décrit le ruolo ricercato ; cet état est colocalisé dans la section ## Description. - L'activité opérationnelle est élevée avec les points d'identité de l'État dans la section ## Mansioni. - Ne pas présenter d'informations sur les exigences, bénéficier de contacts spécifiques ; L'unique information résiduelle est la note finale sur le caractère descriptif du document, qui est insérée dans la section ## Contatto (l'unique section disponible pour le contenu ajouté non classifiable autre). 2. Conversion des points électroniques - Le symbole « • » est remplacé par « - » pour afficher la valeur de markdown sintassi. - Ogni punto è stato mantenuto verbatim, sans alcuna riformulazione, même quando conteneva più frasi (c'est-à-dire le dernier point des demeures). 3. Formatage - Nous utilisons les titres du niveau 2 (`##`) pour la section. - La demande d'introduction est un état lascié qui vient juste à part (avec un effort supplémentaire pour forcer l'interruption de riga) pour maintenir le contenu original en entier. - Il n'est pas ajouté à un test, à une publication ou à un code ajouté à l'extérieur de la structure markdown. --- Descrizione Vous aimez les marchés financiers ? Êtes-vous doué pour gérer et interpréter de grands ensembles de données ? Êtes-vous analytique et aimez-vous enquêter sur les transactions financières, comprendre les stratégies de trading et donner un sens aux activités de trading inhabituelles ? Êtes-vous capable de penser de manière indépendante et d’exprimer vos opinions et vos idées avec confiance ? Nous recherchons un analyste de surveillance commerciale dans un rôle de contributeur individuel avec une expérience dans les domaines suivants : Mansioni - Exécution d'activités automatisées et manuelles de surveillance des comportements sur le marché au sein de la division Banque d'investissement et gestion de patrimoine. - Analyser les cas d'activités potentiellement suspectes signalés par nos systèmes. - S'engager avec les parties prenantes de l'entreprise sur les escalades liées à la conduite du marché et sur d'autres questions. - Conduire des améliorations continues des processus et contribuer aux projets stratégiques et aux initiatives d'automatisation/optimisation. - Effectuer une surveillance commerciale des barrières d'information pour les transactions sur les comptes personnels de l'entreprise, des clients et des employés (PAD). Surveiller le flux d'informations importantes non publiques (MNPI) pour détecter les violations potentielles de la politique de barrière à l'information de l'entreprise, de la liste restreinte et des délits d'initiés. Contact Cette description de poste fournit un examen de haut niveau des types de travail effectués. D'autres tâches liées au poste peuvent être assignées selon les besoins.

en.title: Automation Engineer/Project Engineer: Digital Manufacturing and Data Lab 100% (a)
en.description:
Bachem is a leading, innovation-driven company specializing in the development and manufacture of peptides and oligonucleotides. With over 50 years of experience and expertise Bachem provides products for research, clinical development and commercial application to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide and offers a comprehensive range of services. Bachem operates internationally with headquarters in Switzerland and locations in Europe, the US and Asia. The company is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange. For further information, see www.bachem.com.

As Automation Engineer / Project Engineer for the Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab 100% (m/w/d) , you will play a central role in building, operating, and advancing our laboratory environment for digital manufacturing solutions. You will combine expertise in process automation, simulation, and lab infrastructure to enable engineers, data scientists, and developers to design, test, and deploy innovative solutions.

With a strong focus on PCS7-based automation systems, SIMIT simulations, and lab infrastructure, you will act as a technical allrounder bridging automation, IT/OT development systems, and user enablement. Your work will directly support experimentation, prototyping, and scaling of digital and automation solutions across TechOps and manufacturing.

Your Tasks:

• Design, implement, and maintain the Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab infrastructure, including automation systems, virtualized environments, and network setups

• Develop, configure, and support Siemens PCS7 systems (incl. WinCC, Simatic Batch) for lab and pilot environments

• Build and maintain simulation capabilities and digital twins using SIMIT, enabling virtual commissioning, testing, and training scenarios

• Administer and operate lab IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, systems, and network components

• Integrate controllers, field devices, and lab equipment into cohesive automation and data environments

• Provide and maintain internal tools, templates, and automation libraries for users of the lab

• Support users (engineers, data scientists) in utilizing lab systems for experiments, testing, and troubleshooting

• Participate in automation and digitalization projects, from requirements gathering to prototyping and implementation

• Maintain system documentation, ensure configuration management, and support testing activities where applicable

• Identify opportunities to improve the lab environment and introduce new technologies and best practices

Your Profile:

• University degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field

• Hands-on experience with process control systems, ideally Siemens PCS7, WinCC, and Simatic Batch, as well as simulation tools such as SIMIT or similar platforms

• Solid understanding of automation hardware, PLCs, controllers, field instrumentation, system integration, and industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus)

• Practical knowledge of IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, Windows administration, TCP/IP networking, virtual environments (e.g., VMware, Proxmox), and network segmentation in lab setups

• Exposure to data systems (e.g., historians, MES, analytics platforms), their integration with automation systems, and experience in virtual commissioning and digital twin approaches

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work across disciplines, act as a technical allrounder, and translate user needs into practical technical solutions

• Dedicated, self-driven, structured, and collaborative personality with a hands-on mindset; solid knowledge of German is considered a strong plus

en.title: Mechanical Engineer
en.description:
Mission

We are offering a position as mechanical engineer in the Group of Energy Materials at EPFL, Sion. Our highly interdisciplinary Lab (20 FTE, 1/3rd PhD students, 1/3rd postdocs, 1/3rd engineers) is part of the EPFL Mechanical Engineering Institute and specialised since 30 years in fuel cell and electrolysers, especially for high temperature (>600°C, solid oxide ceramics) and more recently also for low temperature ( We look to complement our engineer team. We design and build stacks, and different customized test benches to characterize our fuel cells, electrolysers, and more complex integrated systems including heat exchangers, chemical reactors, gas recirculation, safety sensors etc.

We are specifically looking for an additional mechanical engineer with a solid experience in computational fluid dynamics and structural mechanics. These competences will be applied during the design of low and high temperature fuel cells and electrolysers, including their balance of plants, under pressurized conditions.

Main duties and responsibilities

More specifically, within our ongoing projects, you will:

• help to finalize our main demonstration installation (10/30 kW full seasonal storage)

• help to construct our 30 kW chemical reactor (20 bar)

• deal with compression of H2, CO2, syngas (20-30 bar), and natural gas grid injection (5 bar)

• manage a 100-kW Power-to-Methane project including a novel electrolyser unit

• maintain and modify existing test benches

• support the design of new test benches (up to 30-50 kW / 50 bar)

• participate in the design of pressurised fuel cell / electrolyser concepts

Profile

• MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Prior professional experience with process flow diagrams, P&ID and HAZOP.

• Prior professional experience with pressurization.

• Prior familiarity with fuel cells, electrolysers, chemical reactors is a plus but not a must.

• Good communication skills and working as part of a team

• Enthusiasm, curiosity, motivation, reactivity, organizational skills, rigor in experimental work

• At least good command of English and preferably also of French (though not mandatory for French)

We offer

• Employment at a renowned institution ranked among the leaders in engineering and technology

• Support for professional development through training and continuous learning opportunities

• Supportive and flexible work environment promoting work-life balance

• Language courses relevant to your role

• International multilingual working environment

• Discounts on public transport

Informations

Your application should contain:

• A motivation letter
• Your detailed CV
• Contact information

• Names and contact information of 2 or more references willing to write a recommendation letter

Application deadline: Apr 15th 2026
Contract Start Date: June 1st 2026 or as per mutual agreement

Activity Rate Min: 80%
Activity Rate Max: 100%
Contract Type: yearly renewed
Duration: up to 5 years

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered.

For more information, please contact: jan.vanherle@epfl.ch, romain.jordan@epfl.ch, thibault.macherel@epfl.ch, sinclair.augereau@epfl.ch, chantal.donaghey@epfl.ch

Mission Wir bieten eine Position als Maschinenbauingenieur in der Gruppe der Energiematerialien bei EPFL, Sion. Unser hoch interdisziplinäres Labor (20 FTE, 1/3rd Doktoranden, 1/3rd Postdocs, 1/3rd Ingenieure) ist Teil des EPFL Maschinenbauinstituts und seit 30 Jahren spezialisiert auf Brennstoffzelle und Elektrolysegeräte, insbesondere für hohe Temperaturen (> 600°C, Festoxidkeramik) und in jüngerer Zeit auch für niedrige Temperaturen (Wir suchen, um unser Ingenieurteam zu ergänzen.

Wir entwerfen und bauen Stapel und verschiedene kundenspezifische Prüfstände, um unsere Brennstoffzellen, Elektrolysegeräte und komplexere integrierte Systeme, einschließlich Wärmetauscher, chemische Reaktoren, Gasrückführung, Sicherheitssensoren usw. zu charakterisieren. Wir suchen speziell einen zusätzlichen Maschinenbauer mit solider Erfahrung in der Berechnungsflüssigkeitsdynamik und Strukturmechanik. Diese Kompetenzen werden bei der Konstruktion von Niedrig- und Hochtemperatur-Brennstoffzellen und Elektrolysegeräten, einschließlich ihrer Anlagenbilanz, unter Druckbedingungen angewendet.

Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten Im Rahmen unserer laufenden Projekte werden Sie: • helfen, unsere Hauptdemonstrationsanlage (10/30 kW vollständige saisonale Lagerung) zu beenden • helfen, unseren 30 kW Chemiereaktor (20 bar) zu bauen • sich mit der Kompression von H2, CO2, Syngas (20-30 bar) und Erdgaseinspritzung (5 bar) befassen • ein 100 kW Power-to-Methan-Projekt mit einer neuartigen Elektrolyseeinheit verwalten • bestehende Prüfstände pflegen und modifizieren • die Konstruktion neuer Prüfstände unterstützen (bis zu 30-50 kW / 50 bar) • an der Gestaltung von Druckstoffzellen-/Elektrolysekonzepten teilnehmen

Profil • MSc-Abschluss in Maschinenbau • Vorzeitige Berufserfahrung mit Prozessflussdiagrammen, P&ID und HAZOP.

• Vorhergehende Berufserfahrung mit Druckmitteln. • Vorhergehende Vertrautheit mit Brennstoffzellen, Elektrolysegeräten, chemischen Reaktoren ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Arbeit als Team • Begeisterung, Neugier, Motivation, Reaktivität, organisatorische Fähigkeiten, Strenge in der experimentellen Arbeit • Mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse und vorzugsweise auch Französisch (obwohl nicht für Französisch erforderlich) Wir bieten • Anstellung in einer renommierten Institution, die unter den führenden Ingenieurs- und Technologieunternehmen geführt wird • Unterstützung der beruflichen Entwicklung durch Ausbildung und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten • Unterstützung und flexibles Arbeitsumfeld zur Förderung der Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben • Sprachkurse, die für Ihre Rolle relevant sind • Internationale mehrsprachige

fr.title: Ingénieur mécanique
fr.description:
Mission Nous vous proposons un poste d'ingénieur en mécanique au sein du Groupe des matériaux énergétiques de l'EPFL, Sion. Notre laboratoire hautement interdisciplinaire (20 ETP, 1/3e doctorant, 1/3e postdocs, 1/3e ingénieur) fait partie de l'Institut d'ingénierie mécanique de l'EPFL et est spécialisé depuis 30 ans dans les piles à combustible et les électrolysers, notamment pour les températures élevées (>600°C, céramiques à oxyde solide) et plus récemment aussi pour les températures basses (Nous cherchons à compléter notre équipe d'ingénieurs.

Nous concevons et construisons des piles et différents bancs d'essai personnalisés pour caractériser nos piles à combustible, nos électrolyseurs et nos systèmes intégrés plus complexes, y compris les échangeurs de chaleur, les réacteurs chimiques, la recirculation de gaz, les capteurs de sécurité, etc. Nous recherchons spécifiquement un ingénieur mécanique supplémentaire ayant une solide expérience en dynamique des fluides informatiques et en mécanique structurelle.

Principales tâches et responsabilités Plus précisément, dans le cadre de nos projets en cours, vous pourrez: • aider à finaliser notre installation de démonstration principale (10/30 kW de stockage saisonnier complet) • aider à construire notre réacteur chimique de 30 kW (20 bar) • traiter la compression de H2, CO2, syngaz (20-30 bar) et l'injection de réseau de gaz naturel (5 bar) • gérer un projet de 100 kW de puissance au méthane comprenant une nouvelle unité d'électrolyse • maintenir et modifier les bancs d'essai existants • soutenir la conception de nouveaux bancs d'essai (jusqu'à 30-50 kW / 50 bar) • participer à la conception de piles à combustible sous pression / concepts d'électrolyse

Profil • Maîtrise en génie mécanique • Expérience professionnelle préalable avec les diagrammes de processus, P&ID et HAZOP.

• Expérience professionnelle préalable en matière de pressurisation. • Connaissance préalable des piles à combustible, des électrolyseurs, des réacteurs chimiques est un atout mais pas un must.

• Bonnes compétences en communication et travail en équipe • Enthousiasme, curiosité, motivation, réactivité, habileté organisationnelle, rigueur dans le travail expérimental • Au moins bonne maîtrise de l'anglais et de préférence aussi du français (mais pas obligatoire pour le français) Nous offrons • Emploi dans une institution de renom classée parmi les leaders en ingénierie et technologie • Soutien au développement professionnel par la formation et les possibilités d'apprentissage continu • Environnement de travail souple et solidaire favorisant l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée • Cours de langues pertinents à votre rôle • Multilinguistique international

environnement de travail • Réductions sur les transports en commun Informations Votre demande doit contenir : • Une lettre de motivation • Votre CV détaillé • Coordonnées • Noms et coordonnées de 2 références ou plus prêts à rédiger une lettre de recommandation Date limite de soumission : 15 avril 2026 Date de début du contrat : 1er juin 2026 ou selon accord mutuel Taux d'activité Min : 80% Taux d'activité Max : 100% Type de contrat : renouvelé annuellement Durée : jusqu'à 5 ans Seules les demandes soumises par la plateforme en ligne sont prises en considération.

Pour de plus amples renseignements, veuillez contacter: jan.vanherle@epfl.ch, ف.jordan@epfl.ch, thibault.macherel@epfl.ch, sinclair.augereau@epfl.ch, chantal.donaghey@epfl.ch

entries.value: Mission Offriamo una posizione come ingegnere meccanico nel Gruppo di Materiali Energetici presso EPFL, Sion. Il nostro Laboratorio altamente interdisciplinare (20 FTE, 1/3° dottorandi, 1/3° postdoc, 1/3° ingegneri) fa parte dell'EPFL Mechanical Engineering Institute ed è specializzato da 30 anni in celle a combustibile ed elettrolizzatori, in particolare per alte temperature (>600° C, ceramiche ad ossido solido) e più recentemente anche per basse temperature ( Cerchiamo di integrare il nostro team di ingegneri. Progettiamo e costruiamo stack e diversi banchi di prova personalizzati per caratterizzare le nostre celle a combustibile, elettrolizzatori e sistemi integrati più complessi tra cui scambiatori di calore, reattori chimici, ricircolo del gas, sensori di sicurezza ecc. Siamo specificamente alla ricerca di un ingegnere meccanico aggiuntivo con una solida esperienza in fluidodinamica computazionale e meccanica strutturale. Queste competenze saranno applicate durante la progettazione di celle a combustibile a bassa e alta temperatura ed elettrolizzatori, compreso il loro equilibrio di impianti, in condizioni di pressione. Principali compiti e responsabilità Più specificamente, nell'ambito dei nostri progetti in corso, dovrai: • aiutare a finalizzare la nostra installazione dimostrativa principale (10/30 kW di stoccaggio stagionale completo) • aiutare a costruire il nostro reattore chimico da 30 kW (20 bar) • occuparti della compressione di H2, CO2, syngas (20-30 bar) e iniezione di rete di gas naturale (5 bar) • gestire un progetto Power-to-Methane da 100 kW che include una nuova unità di elettrolizzatore • mantenere e modificare i banchi di prova esistenti • supporto

en.title: Legal Counsel
en.description:
To strengthen our Legal Services team at our headquarters in Uzwil, we are looking for a motivated and business-minded Legal Counsel who combines strong legal expertise with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across our global organization, advising on a wide range of legal matters and supporting the business in achieving its goals in a compliant and commercially sound way.

Aufgaben:
• You advise internal stakeholders on a broad range of legal matters, with a focus on commercial contracts, IT law, and corporate governance

• You draft, review, and negotiate a variety of agreements, including customer, supplier, and IT-related contracts (software, cloud, SaaS)

• You develop and enhance contract templates, policies, and legal standards, while supporting the continuous improvement of legal processes and tools

• You identify legal risks, monitor regulatory developments, and translate them into practical, business-oriented guidance

• You collaborate cross-functionally and support governance matters, ensuring effective communication with stakeholders at all levels

Anforderungen:
• Swiss law degree and admission to the bar in Switzerland, combined with several years of relevant professional experience in a law firm or in-house environment, ideally in an international, industrial or technology-driven setting

• Strong expertise in contract law, IT law, and corporate governance, with proven experience in drafting and negotiating commercial and IT-related agreements

• Independent, structured working style paired with strong teamwork skills, business acumen, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, along with a high level of integrity, reliability, and sound judgment

• Fluency in German and English; strong interest in digitalization, legal technology, and continuous improvement, combined with curiosity and a willingness to learn

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

en.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
An exciting working environment awaits you at the interface of Veterinary Medicine, Human Medicine and future Technologies. As a member of the veterinary team, you will work on various research projects, which include the following responsibilities:

• Veterinary support, including anesthesia, surgery, pre- and post-operative care for farm animals

• Contact person for researchers and for handling their requests regarding planning and implementing new projects including writing and managing animal experimental licenses

• Advising scientists on aspects of animal welfare and 3Rs

• Active contribution to the smooth running of operations (ordering and organization of consumables and medicines as well as maintenance of the infrastructure)

• Establishment and maintenance of quality standards (Good Laboratory Practice (GLP))

Anforderungen:
• Degree in veterinary medicine eligible to work in Switzerland (doctorate degree optional, newly Grads welcome)

• Interest in working with farm animals

• Great interest in scientific work

• Flair for novel technologies

• You are a reliable, precise and well-organized personality with a quick grasp and an independent and careful way of working, and a high level of responsibility

• You enjoy working independently as well as in a team

• High level of motivation and flexibility (irregular working schedule), including willingness to work on weekends, public holidays and shift work

• You are looking to establish yourself long-term in the field and potentially aspire an academic career

en.title: Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst with Arabic- TALENT POOL
en.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

The Audit and Compliance department provides services for the affiliates in the EMEA region. Our main areas covered are: Financial Compliance, SAP Authorization, Travel and Expense Compliance.

Your Opportunity
As a Travel and Expense Compliance Analyst you will be responsible for working with the finance, audit, compliance and other departments of selected Roche affiliates. In this position you will focus on:

• Verifying T&E expense claims from VAT point of view

• Handling integration between Concur and SAP

• Supporting the preparation of reports and training material where required on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

• Working collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• Taking responsibility for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Participating in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by supervisor/HOD.

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• At least 1 year of experience in a relevant position in the field of Finance/Accounting

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business related field

• Good administrative & communication skills

• High commitment to maintain / improve service levels

• Open mindset and customer focus

• Proficiency in English and Arabic

Desirable:

• Knowledge of finance and accounting principles

• Experience in SAP / Concur system

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (1 office day/week on average, and we provide fully remote working conditions within Hungary). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

En traitant avec les soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, la diversité est un ingrédient essentiel au succès. Nous croyons que l'inclusion est la clé pour comprendre les gens, les besoins de santé variés. Ensemble, nous acceptons l'individualité et partageons une passion pour les soins exceptionnels. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous vous cherchons à rejoindre notre POOL TALENT à notre Centre de services et de solutions Roche à Budapest! Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover.

Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Le service Audit and Compliance fournit des services aux affiliés de la région de l'EMEA. Nos principaux domaines couverts sont: Compliance financière, autorisation SAP, Voyage et Compliance des frais.

Qui êtes-vous?

En tant que membre idéal de l'équipe, vous êtes ouvert d'esprit, dévoué à faire la différence et ouvert à un développement constant.

En outre, vous avez: • Au moins 1 an d'expérience dans un poste pertinent dans le domaine de la finance/la comptabilité • Baccalauréat en comptabilité, finance ou domaine lié aux affaires • Bonnes compétences administratives et de communication • Engagement élevé pour maintenir / améliorer les niveaux de service • Esprit ouvert et orientation client • Compétence en anglais et arabe Désirable: • Connaissance des principes financiers et comptables • Expérience en SAP / Système de contrats En échange nous vous fournissons: • Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage.

## Wir suchen dich!
Im Rahmen der Leistungsvereinbarung mit den Gemeinden Uhwiesen, Dachsen, Flurlingen und Feuerthalen-Langwiesen sorgt die Spitex am Kohlfirst für eine professionelle spitalexterne Pflege und Betreuung der Einwohnerinnen und Einwohner dieser Gemeinden. - Du übernimmst eine wichtige Rolle bei der Pflege und Betreuung unserer Klient:innen.

- Du bist aktiv am Pflegeprozess beteiligt und entwickelst dein Wissen weiter.

- Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, bei denen du dein Fachwissen einsetzen und erweitern kannst.

- Berufliche und fachspezifische Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
- Fortschrittliche, familienfreundliche Arbeitsbedingungen (z. B. mind. 5 Wochen Ferien, fixe Arbeitstage oder nur Spätdienste möglich).

- Ausbildung als Fachperson Gesundheit EFZ.
- Freude daran, selbstständig, verantwortungsbewusst und im Team zu arbeiten.

- Freude am Umgang mit moderner EDV.

Are you ready for an exciting challenge in an extraordinary and diverse work environment? Then join our team! With flat hierarchies and a respectful interaction on an equal footing, we place great emphasis on professional skills and strong social competencies.

Tasks
- You work in day service from Monday to Friday
- You are part of a small team of wound experts, which self-organized cares for our clients at all locations in the field of wounds
- As a specialist for wounds, you are responsible for competent and resource-oriented basic and treatment care of our clients in the field of wounds
- You take over case responsibility for a certain number of clients in the field of wounds, including planning, controlling and monitoring the care process
- With relatives, doctors and other services, you cultivate interdisciplinary cooperation and are the contact person for our employees for wound-related questions

Requirements
- Completed training as a qualified nursing professional HF
- Further training as a wound expert
- Many years of professional experience and broad expertise
- Independent, responsible working method
- Openness, flexibility and empathy
- Willingness to travel by car

What we offer
- No weekend or night work
- We take your personal needs into account when designing your working hours
- Space for personal initiative and professional development
- A motivated team and an open, appreciative company climate

Contact
With us, you will not only find a job, but a meaningful task with perspective! Become part of our dynamic team and help shape the future of healthcare with us.
We look forward to receiving your application! Please send your documents by e-mail to: bewerbung@spitex-regionbirs.ch.
Would you like to know more about us? You can find more information at https://www.spitex-regionbirs.ch/Karriere/PeVU7/

## Descrizione
Du möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen, den Pflegeprozess aktiv gestalten und gleichzeitig nahe bei unseren Klientinnen und Klienten bleiben?
Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
 Wir sind eine wachsende, innovative und zukunftsorientierte Non-Profit-Spitex-Organisation. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams Fallkoordination suchen wir eine engagierte und fachkompetente Persönlichkeit.

## Mansioni
Dipl. Pflegefachperson HF als Fallkoordinator/-in (70-100%)
 Deine Aufgaben
 In dieser vielseitigen Funktion verbindest du professionelle Pflege mit Koordination und Fallführung:
- Du betreust und begleitest Klientinnen und Klienten im Rahmen von Pflegeeinsätzen direkt vor Ort.
- Du koordinierst und organisierst die Leistungserbringung von der Aufnahme bis zum Austritt – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Klientinnen, Angehörigen, Ärzten, Spitälern und weiteren Fachstellen.
- Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den gesamten Pflegeprozess inklusive Bedarfsabklärung, Pflegediagnostik nach NANDA und elektronischer Pflegedokumentation.
- Du delegierst Aufgaben situations- und kompetenzgerecht und unterstützt Mitarbeitende in fachlichen Fragestellungen.
- Du übernimmst Tagesverantwortung und trägst zu einer hohen Pflegequalität bei.
- Du wirkst aktiv bei der Ausbildung von Lernenden mit.

## Requisiti
 Das bringst du mit
- Diplom als Pflegefachperson HF oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung
- Erfahrung in der Bedarfsabklärung mit InterRAI von Vorteil
- Freude an der direkten Pflege sowie an koordinativen Aufgaben
- Hohe Organisations- und Kommunikationskompetenz
- Selbstständige, verantwortungsbewusste und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Offenheit gegenüber Veränderungen und neuen Entwicklungen
- Teamgeist, Engagement und Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen

## Cosa offriamo
 Das erwartet dich
- Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit einer ausgewogenen Kombination aus Pflege, Fallführung und Koordination
- Viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum
- Eine moderne, innovative und wertschätzende Organisation
- Attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- Fortschrittliche Arbeitsbedingungen und flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
- Geregelte Arbeitszeiten unter der Woche
- Ein motiviertes, herzliches Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt

## Contatto
 Möchtest du gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der ambulanten Pflege gestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen.

5 semaines de vacances, jours ouvrables fixes ou seulement services tardifs possibles). de.title: Manager - Corporate Tax
de.description:
Mansioni
- Du berätst international tätige Schweizer und ausländische Unternehmen in Steuerbelangen und erarbeitest massgeschneiderte Lösungsvorschläge für ihre komplexen Problemstellungen.
- Du bist Teil eines inspirierenden Teams, das anspruchsvolle Projekte betreut wie nationale und internationale Unternehmensumstrukturierungen, Transaktionen, Steuerplanungsprojekte und Tax Accounting-Mandate.
- Du entwickelst deine eigenen Führungsqualitäten in einem dynamischen Team mit engagierten Mitarbeitern.
- Du kannst dich in einem Arbeitsumfeld, das von Teamgeist, Vertrauen und gegenseitiger Unterstützung geprägt ist, voll entfalten.
- Du arbeitest an internen und externen Publikationen und Schulungen mit und unterstützt bei fachtechnischen Anlässen.
- Du erwirbst umfassendes technisches Know-how und Soft Skills durch On-and-off-the-Job-Trainings.

Requisiti
- Du hast einen Hochschulabschluss (Uni oder FH) in Betriebswirtschaft oder Recht o.Ä. und vorzugsweise das Schweizer Steuerexperten-Diplom.
- Du besitzt mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Unternehmenssteuerrecht in der Beratung oder der Industrie, allenfalls auch im Bereich Tax Accounting (IFRS oder US GAAP).
- Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
- Du übernimmst die Führung deines Teams und die Verantwortung für deinen Fachbereich und deine Projekte.
- Du bist engagiert, flexibel sowie eine team- und kundenorientierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgezeichneten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
- Du siehst die grösseren Zusammenhänge und stellst deinen Unternehmergeist und dein Können im Bereich Geschäftsentwicklung gerne unter Beweis.

- Sviluppi le tue qualità di leadership in un team dinamico composto da collaboratori motivati.

- Collabori alla realizzazione di pubblicazioni e formazioni interne ed esterne e supporti eventi tecnici.

Requisiti
- Possiedi una laurea universitaria (università o scuola universitaria professionale) in economia aziendale o giurisprudenza o ambiti affini e, preferibilmente, il diploma svizzero di esperto fiscale.
- Disponi di almeno 4 anni di esperienza professionale nel diritto tributario delle imprese, nel settore della consulenza o dell'industria, eventualmente anche nell'ambito del Tax Accounting (IFRS o US GAAP).

- Du entwickelst deine eigenen Führungsqualitäten in einem dynamischen Team mit engagierten Mitarbeitern.

dans le domaine de l'OTT, de l'automatisation, de l'IA) DEINE SKILLS: - expérience dans un gestionnaire de produits techniques, de la plate-forme ou du rôle d'intégration de système - bonne compréhension des plates-formes d'OTT/streaming; compréhension des modèles numériques de l'avantage - expérience dans la manipulation des API et des intégrations de systèmes ainsi que des systèmes de CRM, de paiement ou d'analyse - compréhension de base des structures de données, des flux de données et des processus de développement logiciel (Agile, Releases,105) - expérience pluriannuelle dans le domaine de l'ingénierie du marché germano-américain incl.

en.title: AI/ML Engineer & MLOps 80-100%
en.description:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

At ADAO (AI, Data and Agentic Enablement Office), we bring people together to unlock the future of Sunrise through data, analytics, AI, and agentic technologies. We think big, move with purpose, and turn ideas into real impact for our customers and teams. ADAO is where innovation meets trust: we build strong data foundations, scale safe and reliable AI capabilities, and empower business units through a hub‑and‑spoke operating model to deliver meaningful results across the company. Within this model, you will work as part of the Agentic Enablement and Prompt Engineering & Conversation Design team, where the central hub provides standards, platforms, architecture, and best practices, while cross‑functional, outcome‑driven Pods are embedded in and led by the business. You will act as an engineering expert, partnering closely with the business to deliver on their priorities and outcomes.

In this role you will design, build, deploy and operate production grade ML and GenAI solutions, including RAG components where applicable, that deliver measurable business value for Sunrise, ensuring end-to-end lifecycle excellence from experimentation to automated deployment, monitoring, risk controls and continuous improvement in alignment with ADAO standards and governance.

You will be part of the central AI/ML Engineering & MLOps chapter within the ADAO Hub, supporting embedded Domain Pods through reusable platform components, engineering standards and hands-on delivery.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Develop & industrialize ML/GenAI solutions: Translate business roadmaps into solution designs while implementing robust training/inference pipelines and production services that meet all non‑functional requirementsCo-design solution architectures with Data Scientists and Domain Pods (batch/real-time, APIs, RAG patterns where relevant)Industrialize prototypes: automated tests, secure packaging, deployment/rollback, and performance/cost tuning
- Co-design solution architectures with Data Scientists and Domain Pods (batch/real-time, APIs, RAG patterns where relevant)
- Industrialize prototypes: automated tests, secure packaging, deployment/rollback, and performance/cost tuning

- Own & evolve MLOps/LLMOps pipelines: Build standardized CI/CD workflows, manage model promotion through dev→test→prod, and maintain monitoring and drift/retraining mechanismsMaintain standard CI/CD/CT templates incl. model/prompt packaging, validation gates, and dev→test→prod promotionOperate model registry/versioning and automated retraining triggers aligned to ADAO governance and CIO/IT change windows
- Maintain standard CI/CD/CT templates incl. model/prompt packaging, validation gates, and dev→test→prod promotion
- Operate model registry/versioning and automated retraining triggers aligned to ADAO governance and CIO/IT change windows

- Operate experimentation & feature management: Provide reproducible experimentation, manage feature store patterns and validation, and promote reusable datasets/features across PodsProvide experiment tracking, dataset/feature versioning and feature-store patterns (offline/online parity)Run evaluation harnesses for ML & GenAI (regression, A/B tests, safety & multilingual checks) and share reusable assets
- Provide experiment tracking, dataset/feature versioning and feature-store patterns (offline/online parity)
- Run evaluation harnesses for ML & GenAI (regression, A/B tests, safety & multilingual checks) and share reusable assets

- Model documentation, governance & risk: Produce compliant model documentation, implement required governance/security/privacy controls, and support GenAI safety and auditability measuresProduce model cards and compliance artefacts (data sources, limitations, privacy/bias controls) and evidence for auditsImplement Responsible AI / GenAI guardrails: grounding, HITL approvals, audit logs, and risk reviews with governance teams
- Produce model cards and compliance artefacts (data sources, limitations, privacy/bias controls) and evidence for audits
- Implement Responsible AI / GenAI guardrails: grounding, HITL approvals, audit logs, and risk reviews with governance teams

- Observability, reliability & incident response: Implement full observability for models and services, maintain runbooks and alerting, participate in incident resolution, and drive reliability improvementsDefine SLOs/SLIs and implement monitoring/alerting for quality, drift, latency, availability and costMaintain runbooks, participate in on-call/incident postmortems, and drive corrective actions
- Define SLOs/SLIs and implement monitoring/alerting for quality, drift, latency, availability and cost
- Maintain runbooks, participate in on-call/incident postmortems, and drive corrective actions

- Enablement & reusable components: Provide reusable ML/GenAI components, coach teams on MLOps/LLMOps best practices and ensure consistent engineering standards across Hub and PodsBuild reusable libraries and reference implementations (RAG connectors, evaluation utilities, deployment scaffolding)Coach Pod engineers through reviews, pairing and clinics; contribute to ADAO AI Academy materials
- Build reusable libraries and reference implementations (RAG connectors, evaluation utilities, deployment scaffolding)
- Coach Pod engineers through reviews, pairing and clinics; contribute to ADAO AI Academy materials

- Key deliverables (illustrative):Standard ML/LLMOps pipeline template + reference architectures (batch/real-time/RAG)Model registry & artefact versioning (models, prompts, datasets, features)Monitoring dashboards + drift detection + SLO reportingGenAI evaluation test suite (regression, safety, multilingual) and acceptance thresholdsModel documentation pack and operational runbooks (audit-ready)
- Standard ML/LLMOps pipeline template + reference architectures (batch/real-time/RAG)
- Model registry & artefact versioning (models, prompts, datasets, features)
- Monitoring dashboards + drift detection + SLO reporting
- GenAI evaluation test suite (regression, safety, multilingual) and acceptance thresholds
- Model documentation pack and operational runbooks (audit-ready)

YOUR SKILLS:

- Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience
- 3+ years in ML engineering, MLOps, software/data engineering or related roles, with proven end-to-end production of ML/GenAI solutions
- Hands‑on CI/CD and DevOps for ML workloads (testing, version control, release management), plus IaC (Terraform/Pulumi) and GitOps
- Experience with ML frameworks (scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) and serving patterns (REST/gRPC, batch, streaming), and MLOps tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, Vertex AI, SageMaker)
- Strong Python software engineering (testing, APIs), containers (Docker) and cloud deployment patterns; GenAI/RAG experience is a plus
- Familiarity with feature stores, experiment tracking, data quality testing and orchestration tools (Airflow/Dagster/Prefect), working in cross-functional Hub and Pod setups
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, ownership mindset and reliability under pressure with a structured engineering approach
- Ability to influence without formal authority, champion standards across Hub and Pods, and continuously adapt to evolving AI/ML technologies; telecommunications experience is a plus

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together. Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value. Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future! #ChallengersWanted Information for agencies: Application dossiers sent or uploaded by placement agencies or similar are not desired, will therefore not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-SJ1

Chez Sunrise, nous pensons plus grand, nous allons plus loin et nous créons de nouvelles idées. Pour nous, la culture de travail signifie réaliser de grandes choses ensemble. C'est là que le respect et les idées innovantes se combinent avec un véritable travail d'équipe – chaque voix compte, chaque perspective nous rend plus forts. Notre passion nous pousse à essayer de nouvelles choses et à grandir continuellement. Sonnez comme vous? Ensuite, rejoignez notre histoire de réussite.

Nous pensons grand, nous mouvons avec objectif et nous transformons les idées en un impact réel pour nos clients et nos équipes. ADAO est là où l'innovation répond à la confiance : nous construisons des bases de données solides, épargnons des capacités d'IA sûres et fiables et autonomisons les unités commerciales grâce à un modèle opérationnel sur mesure pour obtenir des résultats significatifs dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.

Dans ce modèle, vous travaillerez dans le cadre de l'équipe Agentic Enablement Engineering & Conversation Design, où le centre central fournit des normes, des plateformes, de l'architecture et des pratiques exemplaires, tandis que les pods interfonctionnels et axés sur les résultats sont intégrés dans l'entreprise et dirigés par elle. Vous agirez comme un expert en ingénierie, en partenariat étroit avec l'entreprise pour réaliser leurs priorités et leurs résultats.

en.title: Lead Generation Specialist B2B 50%
en.description:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you identify and acquire qualified business contacts. With your strong understanding of B2B markets, your data-driven approach, and your excellent communication skills, you unlock new sales potential and actively contribute to the sustainable growth of our company.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Identify and proactively approach potential business customers
- Develop and implement lead generation strategies and prepare qualified contacts
- Schedule appointments and hand them over to the sales team
- Develop tailored solutions based on customer needs
- Build and maintain long-term customer relationships
- Collaborate closely with the marketing team to execute sales campaigns
- Use CRM and analytics tools to optimize and streamline processes

YOUR SKILLS:

- Experience in sales, telemarketing, or B2B lead generation
- Strong communication and negotiation skills
- Proficiency in using CRM systems and digital sales tools
- Independent, structured, and goal-oriented working style
- Analytical thinking and strong problem-solving abilities
- Team-oriented with a high level of assertiveness
- Very good German skills and good English skills, both written and spoken

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together.

Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value.

Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future!

fr.title: Spécialiste de la génération de plomb B2B 50%
fr.description:
À Sunrise, nous pensons plus grand, nous allons plus loin et nous créons de nouvelles idées. Pour nous, la culture de travail signifie réaliser de grandes choses ensemble. C'est là que le respect et les idées innovantes se combinent avec un véritable travail d'équipe – chaque voix compte, chaque perspective nous rend plus forts. Notre passion nous pousse à essayer de nouvelles choses et à grandir continuellement. Sonnez comme vous? Ensuite, rejoignez notre histoire de réussite.

Grâce à votre solide compréhension des marchés B2B, à votre approche basée sur les données et à vos excellentes compétences en communication, vous débloquez de nouveaux potentiels de vente et contribuez activement à la croissance durable de notre entreprise.

VOS DÉFIS : - Identifier et aborder de façon proactive les clients potentiels - Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de production de plomb et préparer des contacts qualifiés - Planifier les rendez-vous et les remettre à l'équipe de vente - Développer des solutions adaptées aux besoins des clients - Établir et maintenir des relations client à long terme - Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe de marketing pour exécuter des campagnes de vente - Utiliser des outils de CRM et d'analyse pour optimiser et rationaliser les processus VOS SKILLS : - Expérience en ventes, télémarketing ou génération de plomb B2B - Fortes compétences en communication et en négociation -

Compétence en utilisation des systèmes CRM et des outils de vente numériques - Style de travail indépendant, structuré et orienté vers l'objectif - Réflexion analytique et fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes - Travail d'équipe avec un haut niveau d'affirmation - Très bonnes compétences allemandes et de bonnes compétences anglaises, à la fois écrites et parlées À Sunrise, vous travaillerez dans un environnement dynamique et multinational où chaque voix est entendue, les perspectives sont partagées et les valeurs sont vécues.

En célébrant nos différences, nous accomplissons de grandes choses ensemble. Sunrise s'est associée à «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». Nous avons également reçu le label LGBTI suisse et la certification «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» comme reconnaissance pour avoir offert à tous nos employés un salaire égal pour un travail de valeur égale. Prêt à relever le défi? Ensuite, rejoignez l'équipe et façonnez activement notre avenir!

## Descrizione
Helvetic Warranty GmbH ist un dipendente Schweizer azienda nel settore dell'assicurazione integrata e leader nel mercato svizzero. Offriamo coperture personalizzate per la DACH-region e cresciamo rapidamente in questo settore. Da 2019 siamo una società filiale di Helvetia Versicherungen. Come intermediario tra clienti e assicuratori offriamo soluzioni B2B2C, dal prodotto alla formazione degli operatori fino alla gestione dei danni. Per oltre 10 anni, uniamo le nostre servizi centralmente in Svizzera e comuniciamo in tutte le lingue nazionali e in inglese. Cerchiamo talenti motivati che ci aiuteranno a definire il futuro dell'assicurazione degli oggetti in questo mercato in crescita.

## Mansioni
- Gestisci i nostri partner di vendita con impegno e sviluppa il loro potenziale
- Pianifica, organizza e guida le formazione dei prodotti, le sessioni di vendita e le formazione specialistiche
- Accompagna l'introduzione delle soluzioni di assicurazione nei nostri partner e porta novità sul mercato
- Assicurati che i nostri partner siano sempre ben informati sui prodotti, i processi e i sistemi – qualità e conoscenza sono al centro
- Supporta le azioni di vendita e le misure di incentivazione – insieme raggiungiamo i nostri obiettivi
- Identifica i potenziali di mercato e sviluppa nuove opportunità di business – le tue idee portano il nostro crescita
- Collabora strettamente con vari team come il gestione dei prodotti, le operazioni e la gestione dei danni – il lavoro di squadra è una nostra priorità
- Sei pronto a viaggiare e porti una disponibilità di viaggio del 70% – la diversità e la vicinanza ai nostri partner sono garantite
- Luogo di lavoro: Dietlikon

## Requisiti
- Hai una formazione commerciale o una qualificazione simile – una formazione in Sales o in gestione aziendale è un grande plus
- Hai esperienza lavorativa nella branca dell'assicurazione, preferibilmente nel settore vendita – il tuo sapere e la tua esperienza ti rendono un forte partner per il nostro team
- Esperienza nella formazione, nell'addestramento o nel coaching è un vantaggio – puoi attivamente contribuire alla crescita dei nostri partner
- Hai competenze eccellenti nella comunicazione, nella presentazione e nella moderazione – con la tua personalità ispirai e mediatizzano i contenuti in modo efficace
- Ti piace il contatto con le persone e sei talentuoso nel costruire e mantenere le relazioni
- Mostri alta iniziativa, autonomia e capacità di lavorare in modo strutturato – così costruisci il tuo successo in modo attivo
- Hai eccellenti conoscenze linguistiche in tedesco – comunichi chiaramente, precisi e con stile

Il team Helvetia è insieme quando è necessario. Siamo persone su cui si può fare affidamento. Siamo qui per supportare, per lavorare insieme, per incoraggiare e per incoraggiarci. Siamo qui per ispirare e per essere ispirati. Così costruiamo insieme il futuro. &Los!

Helvetia Warranty GmbH est une entreprise suisse dans le secteur de l'assurance intégrée et leader sur le marché suisse. de.title: Studentische Hilfskraft KI-Tutorate
de.description:
Als grösste Universität der Schweiz bietet die Universität Zürich eine Vielzahl von attraktiven Positionen in verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Berufsfeldern. Mit rund 10'000 Mitarbeitenden und aktuell 12 Berufsprofilen für Lernende bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in der Spitzenforschung und Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten bei uns ein. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeberin!

Aufgaben:
• Organisatorische Betreuung der Tutorate und Tageskurse: Anmeldungsverwaltung, Raumbuchungen, Materialversand, Kommunikation mit Tutor*innen und Studierenden, Vorbereitung und Versand der Kursevaluationen

• Allgemeine Unterstützung der Kursleitung im laufenden Programm

• Recherche-Unterstützung: Sichtung neuer Studien zur KI-Nutzung in der Hochschullehre, Beobachtung regulatorischer Entwicklungen auf EU- und Bundesebene, Aktualisierung der Bibliographie

Anforderungen:
Sie befinden sich im laufenden oder abgeschlossenen Bachelorstudium der Rechtswissenschaft (BLaw); ein abgeschlossenes Masterstudium ist nicht vorgesehen.
Sie bringen Interesse an Fragen der juristischen Ausbildung und am Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz im Hochschulkontext mit. Eine solide Anwendungserfahrung mit gängigen KI-Tools (insbesondere grossen Sprachmodellen) wird vorausgesetzt; vertiefte technische Kenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich, aber von Vorteil.
Sie arbeiten selbständig, strukturiert und verlässlich. Sie sind kommunikativ und können sich in administrativen Abläufen sicher bewegen. Erfahrungen in der Recherche, im Umgang mit wissenschaftlichen Texten oder in administrativen Funktionen sind willkommen.
Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem oder gleichwertigem Niveau sind Voraussetzung.

Wir bieten:
Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren von vielfältigen und attraktiven Angeboten. Erfahre mehr unter: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

it.title: Assistente studente di tutoraggio A.I.
it.description:
L'Università di Zurigo, la più grande università della Svizzera, offre una vasta gamma di posizioni interessanti in vari campi di studio e carriera. Con circa 10.000 dipendenti e attualmente 12 profili professionali per i lavoratori, l'Università offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante nella ricerca e nell'istruzione di alto livello. Utilizzate con noi il vostro talento e le vostre competenze. Learn più circa l'UZH come datore di lavoro!

Compiti: • Controllo organizzativo dei tutorial e dei corsi giornalieri: Gestione delle registrazioni, prenotazioni delle stanze, invio di materiale, comunicazione con tutor e studenti, preparazione e invio del corso. • Supporto generale della gestione dei corsi nell'attuale programma. • Supporto alla ricerca: Avvistamento di nuovi studi sull'uso degli AI nell'insegnamento universitario, monitoraggio degli sviluppi normativi a livello UE e federale.

La laurea magistrale non e' programmata.

Sono interessati all'educazione legale e all'uso dell'intelligenza artificiale nel contesto accademico. E' necessaria una solida esperienza di applicazione con strumenti AI comuni (soprattutto modelli linguistici di grandi dimensioni); non è richiesta una conoscenza tecnica approfondita, ma di vantaggio. Lavorano in modo indipendente, strutturato e affidabile. Sono comunicativi e possono muoversi in sicurezza nei processi amministrativi. Sono benvenute esperienze di ricerca, di gestione di testi scientifici o di funzioni amministrative.

Sono richieste competenze linguistiche tedesche a livello nativo o equivalente. Offriamo: I nostri dipendenti beneficiano di una vasta gamma di offerte interessanti. Per saperne di più, consultare il sito: https://www.uzh.ch/en/explore/work.html.

en.title: Student assistant AI tutoring
en.description:
As the largest university in Switzerland, the University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various fields of study and career. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional profiles for learners, the University offers an inspiring working environment in top research and education. Use your talent and skills with us. Learn more about the UZH as an employer!

Tasks: • Organizational supervision of the tutorials and day courses: Registration management, room bookings, material dispatch, communication with tutors and students, preparation and dispatch of the course. • General support of the course management in the current programme. • Research support: Sighting of new studies on AI use in university teaching, monitoring of regulatory developments at EU and federal level.

Master's degree is not planned.

They are interested in legal education and the use of artificial intelligence in the academic context. A solid application experience with common AI tools (especially large language models) is required; in-depth technical knowledge is not required, but of advantage. They work independently, structured and reliable. They are communicative and can move safely in administrative processes. Experiences in research, in the handling of scientific texts or in administrative functions are welcome.

German language skills at a native or equivalent level are required. We offer: Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more at: https://www.uzh.ch/en/explore/work.html.

de.title: Gastprofessur für Islamische Theologie und Bildung
de.description:
Als grösste Universität der Schweiz bietet die Universität Zürich eine Vielzahl von attraktiven Positionen in verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Berufsfeldern. Mit rund 10'000 Mitarbeitenden und aktuell 12 Berufsprofilen für Lernende bietet die Universität ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in der Spitzenforschung und Bildung. Setzen Sie Ihr Talent und Ihre Fähigkeiten bei uns ein. Erfahren Sie mehr über die UZH als Arbeitgeberin!

Aufgaben:
Zweck der Gastprofessur ist die Abhaltung von Lehrveranstaltungen zu Themen der islamischen Theologie und/oder Bildung unter Berücksichtigung des kulturell, religiös und weltanschaulich pluralen Kontextes europäischer Gesellschaften der Gegenwart.

Das Lehrpensum umfasst 6 SWS: eine Vorlesung (2 SWS) für Hörer:innen aller Fakultäten an der Universität Zürich (UZH), ein Seminar oder eine Übung (2 SWS) an der UZH und ein weiteres Seminar oder eine Übung (ggf. mit demselben Inhalt) am Schweizerischen Zentrum für Islam und Gesellschaft (SZIG) an der Universität Freiburg. Die Lehrveranstaltungen können aufeinander bezogen sein, interdisziplinäre Formate sind möglich bzw. erwünscht.

Da das Konzept der Gastprofessur eine Ausstrahlung in die breitere Öffentlichkeit vorsieht, wird ein entsprechendes Engagement erwartet wie z.B. Vorträge in Schulklassen und Gemeinden.

Die Gastprofessur wird durch eine Hilfsassistenz unterstützt.

Anforderungen:
Vorausgesetzt werden universitäre Qualifikation (mindestens Promotion), selbständige Forschungstätigkeit und Erfahrung in universitärer Lehre sowie ein Interesse am Dialog auch ausserhalb der Universität.

Wir bieten:
Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren von vielfältigen und attraktiven Angeboten. Erfahre mehr unter: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

en.title: Visiting Professorship for Islamic Theology and Education
en.description:
As the largest university in Switzerland, the University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various fields of study and career. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional profiles for learners, the University offers an inspiring working environment in top research and education. Use your talent and skills with us. Learn more about the UZH as an employer!

Tasks: The purpose of the guest professorship is to hold courses on topics of Islamic theology and/or education, taking into account the cultural, religious and ideologically plural context of European societies of the present. The lecture program comprises 6 SWS: a lecture (2 SWS) for listeners:in all faculties at the University of Zurich (UZH), a seminar or exercise (2 SWS) at the UZH and another seminar or exercise (if necessary with the same content) at the Swiss Center for Islam and Society (SZIG) at the University of Freiburg.

We offer: Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more at: https://www.uzh.ch/en/explore/work.html.

en.title: PhD position: Multi-temporal forest canopy height reconstruction from satellite data
en.description:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer!

Aufgaben:
• Process and analyse large archives of optical stereo satellite imagery.

• Develop and improve photogrammetric workflows for DSM and CHM generation.

• Generate and validate multi-temporal canopy height models.

• Analyse long-term forest structural dynamics and disturbance processes.

• Publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and present them at international conferences.

• Contribute to teaching activities within the Department of Geography.

Anforderungen:
You hold a MSc degree in photogrammetry, remote sensing, geomatics, geodesy, physical geography, environmental sciences, computer science, geoinformatics, aero/astro engineering, or a related discipline.

Experience or strong interest in at least one of the following:
• Satellite or airborne remote sensing data processing/analysis

• Stereo photogrammetry and/or SfM software (open-source or commercial)

• Very-high-resolution commercial satellite image processing and/or analysis

• Airborne LiDAR, and/or spaceborne laser altimetry (GEDI, ICESat-2) analysis

• Geospatial data processing

• Scientific programming (Python, R, Julia, or Matlab)
Other relevant, but optional experience (ideally one or more):
• Point cloud processing and/or analysis

• Computer vision and/or machine learning involving geospatial data

• Forest science

• Linux, Git/Github, Jupyter, Cloud computing

• Open-source geospatial stack (e.g., GDAL, PDAL, GeoPandas, xarray)

• Excellent written and oral communication skills (publication or other technical writing, conference poster or talk)
We offer

• A fully funded 4-year PhD position.

• Access to unique international remote sensing datasets.

• Project collaboration with leading forest and remote sensing researchers across Europe (such as WSL, TU Wien, NIBIO, and IGE Grenoble) and Canada (Canadian Forest Service).

• Excellent research infrastructure and computational resources.

• A stimulating and supportive research environment at the University of Zurich.

• Opportunity to collaborate with both remote sensing and machine learning research groups at the University of Zurich.

Wir bieten:
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

it.title: Posizione di dottorato: Ricostruzione multi-temporale dell'altezza della chioma forestale da dati satellitari
it.description:
L'Università di Zurigo, la più grande università della Svizzera, offre una gamma di posizioni interessanti in vari ambiti disciplinari e professionali. Con circa 10.000 dipendenti e attualmente 12 percorsi di apprendistato professionale, l'Università offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante per la ricerca all'avanguardia e l'istruzione di alto livello. Metti il tuo talento e le tue competenze al servizio di UZH. Scopri di più su UZH come datore di lavoro!

Compiti:
• Elaborare e analizzare grandi archivi di immagini satellitari ottiche stereo.

• Sviluppare e migliorare i flussi di lavoro fotogrammetrici per la generazione di DSM e CHM.

• Generare e validare modelli di altezza della chioma multi-temporali.

• Analizzare la dinamica strutturale a lungo termine delle foreste e i processi di disturbo.

• Pubblicare i risultati della ricerca su riviste peer-reviewed e presentarli a conferenze internazionali.

• Contribuire alle attività didattiche all'interno del Dipartimento di Geografia.

Requisiti:
È richiesto un titolo di MSc in fotogrammetria, telerilevamento, geomatica, geodesia, geografia fisica, scienze ambientali, informatica, geoinformatica, ingegneria aerospaziale/astronautica o disciplina correlata.

Esperienza o forte interesse in almeno uno dei seguenti ambiti:
• Elaborazione/analisi di dati di telerilevamento satellitare o aereo

• Fotogrammetria stereo e/o software SfM (open-source o commerciale)

• Elaborazione e/o analisi di immagini satellitari commerciali ad altissima risoluzione

• Analisi di dati LiDAR aerei e/o altimetria laser spaziale (GEDI, ICESat-2)

• Elaborazione di dati geospaziali

• Programmazione scientifica (Python, R, Julia o Matlab)

Altre esperienze rilevanti, ma opzionali (idealmente una o più):
• Elaborazione e/o analisi di nuvole di punti

• Visione artificiale e/o machine learning applicati ai dati geospaziali

• Scienze forestali

• Linux, Git/Github, Jupyter, Cloud computing

• Stack geospaziale open-source (ad es. GDAL, PDAL, GeoPandas, xarray)

• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale (pubblicazioni o altra scrittura tecnica, poster o presentazione a conferenze)

Offriamo:

• Una posizione di dottorato completamente finanziata di 4 anni.

• Accesso a dataset internazionali unici di telerilevamento.

• Collaborazione di progetto con ricercatori leader nel campo delle foreste e del telerilevamento in tutta Europa (come WSL, TU Wien, NIBIO e IGE Grenoble) e Canada (Canadian Forest Service).

• Eccellente infrastruttura di ricerca e risorse computazionali.

• Un ambiente di ricerca stimolante e di supporto presso l'Università di Zurigo.

• Opportunità di collaborare con gruppi di ricerca in telerilevamento e machine learning presso l'Università di Zurigo.

I nostri dipendenti beneficiano di una vasta gamma di offerte interessanti. Scopri di più: https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.

• Entwicklung und Verbesserung photogrammetrischer Workflows zur DSM- und CHM-Erstellung.

• Erstellung und Validierung multitemporaler Kronenhöhenmodelle.

• Analyse langfristiger struktureller Dynamik und Störungsprozesse im Wald.

fr.title: Poste de doctorat : Reconstruction multi-temporelle de la hauteur de la canopée forestière à partir de données satellites
fr.description:
L'Université de Zurich, la plus grande université de Suisse, propose une gamme de postes attractifs dans divers domaines et secteurs professionnels. Avec environ 10 000 employés et actuellement 12 filières d'apprentissage professionnel, l'université offre un environnement de travail inspirant pour une recherche de pointe et une formation de haut niveau. Mettez votre talent et vos compétences à profit avec nous. Découvrez-en plus sur l'UZH en tant qu'employeur !

Tâches :
• Traiter et analyser de vastes archives d'imagerie satellite optique stéréo.

• Développer et améliorer des workflows photogrammétriques pour la génération de DSM et CHM.

• Générer et valider des modèles multi-temporels de hauteur de canopée.

• Analyser la dynamique structurelle à long terme des forêts et les processus de perturbation.

• Publier les résultats de recherche dans des revues à comité de lecture et les présenter lors de conférences internationales.

• Contribuer aux activités d'enseignement au sein du Département de Géographie.

Exigences :
Vous êtes titulaire d'un master (MSc) en photogrammétrie, télédétection, géomatique, géodésie, géographie physique, sciences de l'environnement, informatique, géoinformatique, ingénierie aérospatiale/astronautique ou une discipline apparentée.

Expérience ou fort intérêt pour au moins l'un des domaines suivants :
• Traitement/analyse de données de télédétection satellitaire ou aéroportée

• Photogrammétrie stéréo et/ou logiciel SfM (open-source ou commercial)

• Traitement et/ou analyse d'images satellites commerciales à très haute résolution

• Analyse de LiDAR aéroporté et/ou altimétrie laser spatiale (GEDI, ICESat-2)

• Traitement de données géospatiales

• Programmation scientifique (Python, R, Julia ou Matlab)

Autres expériences pertinentes, mais optionnelles (idéalement une ou plusieurs) :
• Traitement et/ou analyse de nuages de points

• Vision par ordinateur et/ou apprentissage automatique appliqué aux données géospatiales

• Sciences forestières

• Linux, Git/Github, Jupyter, Cloud computing

• Stack géospatial open-source (par exemple GDAL, PDAL, GeoPandas, xarray)

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale (publication ou autre rédaction technique, poster ou présentation en conférence)

Nous offrons :

• Un poste de doctorat entièrement financé sur 4 ans.

• Accès à des ensembles de données de télédétection internationaux uniques.

• Collaboration de projet avec des chercheurs leaders en foresterie et télédétection à travers l'Europe (tels que WSL, TU Wien, NIBIO et IGE Grenoble) et au Canada (Service canadien des forêts).

• Excellente infrastructure de recherche et ressources informatiques.

• Un environnement de recherche stimulant et soutenant à l'Université de Zurich.

• Opportunité de collaborer avec des groupes de recherche en télédétection et apprentissage automatique à l'Université de Zurich.

Nos employés bénéficient d'une large gamme d'offres attractives. En savoir plus : https://www.uzh.ch/de/explore/work.html.
