## Mission

The Institutional Affairs Unit supports EPFL Presidency in the national and international positioning of the School, contributes to its development, and helps promote its interests. The position will support science-policy efforts and engagement at the national level, promote EPFL’s various expertise towards national and cantonal policy stakeholders and herewith contribute to EPFL’s impact strategy 2025-2028 and to the implementation of its Axis 5 ‘Increase engagement for policy and diplomacy’.

## Main duties and responsibilities

### Implement an interface between EPFL’s academic community and policy stakeholders

- Set up and operate a central institutional access point within the Institutional Affairs Unit and in close collaboration with the Vice-Presidency for Innovation and Impact and Mediacom
- Define and provide streamlined processes through which researchers can request support and access first-line resources
- Keep up to date a dynamic mapping of policy stakeholders engaging with EPFL and of EPFL’s experts involved in science-policy
- Structure and consolidate feedback that informs and feeds into EPFL’s Impact strategy

### Advance science-policy efforts through tailored preparation and internal capacity building

- Based on the monitoring of federal or cantonal policy developments, offer tailored support and preparation for the academic community, including providing background information and drafting reports in coordination with relevant EPFL actors (centers, faculties, vice-presidencies)
- Organize internal training and workshops to build internal capacity in cooperation with Mediacom

### Foster contacts and network building of EPFL’s academic community with policy stakeholders

- Facilitate regular exchanges between academic experts and policy stakeholders through meetings and other relevant formats
- Proactively plan events connecting EPFL experts with policymakers on emerging topics to build networks and trusted relationships
- Ensure coherent representation of EPFL’s academic community as well as coherence with institutional messaging in engagement with national and cantonal political actors, together with the Institutional Affairs Unit
- Participate in internal working groups

## Requirements

- University degree Master level or PhD
- At least 3 years of professional experience in knowledge brokering, political communication or political affairs
- Demonstrated competency in project management and scientific communication

## Profile

- Professional experience in knowledge brokering, political communication or political affairs, with in‑depth knowledge of Swiss federal and cantonal institutions and the national political landscape
- Solid understanding of institutional processes of a higher-education institution, ideally gained through work in academia or related sectors
- Excellent understanding of cantonal and federal political processes, especially in domains such as energy, environment, health and digital policy (an asset)
- Excellent written and oral communication abilities in French and English, and professional proficiency in German
- Demonstrated ability to coordinate engagement activities, manage diverse stakeholders, and structure efficient and coherent institutional processes

## What we offer

- A stimulating, dynamic, interdisciplinary working environment
- The opportunity to be involved in a variety of innovative projects
- An inclusive workspace and equal opportunities for all

## Research Challenge

The Research Challenge: AI training costs are exploding, largely due to energy and bandwidth inefficiencies in current electrical datacenters.

Our group is developing a novel Optical Circuit Switched (OCS) architecture that drastically reduces power and latency.

We are looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher / Research Engineer with a background in Embedded Systems and Low-Level Programming to design the control logic that powers this new hybrid network.

Your code will directly enable the next generation of energy-efficient AI clusters.

## Project Scope

• You will bridge the gap between custom optical hardware and standard AI software stacks .
• Unlike typical high-level networking roles, this project requires "bare-metal" intervention, programming the firmware and drivers that decide how and when data moves.

## Role & Profile

You will lead the implementation of the system's data plane, applying embedded design principles to high-performance networking:

• SmartNIC & FPGA Programming: Implement real-time flow steering logic on devices like NVIDIA BlueField, AMD Pensando or similar.
• Driver Development: Develop and optimize Linux kernel modules and userspace drivers (DPDK) to manage flows.
• Hardware/Software Co-Design: Collaborate with optical physicists to translate physical layer constraints into efficient C/C++ control firmware.
• Evaluation: Benchmark the system against standard IP fabrics and publish results in top-tier conferences (SIGCOMM, NSDI, OSDI).

## Requirements

We are looking for a candidate who is comfortable "looking under the hood" of the operating system. You do not need prior experience with optics.

• PhD/Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
• Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Linux Systems Programming .
• Experience with Embedded Linux and Kernel drivers.

## Bonus Skills (Nice to have)

• Familiarity with Network Interface Cards (NICs) or packet processing (eBPF, XDP).
• Experience bringing up custom hardware boards.

## What we offer

• A stimulating and international working environment
• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions – more information can be found on our website (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)
• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe.
• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

## Contact

- Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered.
- You are asked to supply:
  - Your CV
  - A brief statement of interests
  - A link to your code portfolio (GitHub/GitLab)
- For any further information, please contact: mustafa.yildirim@epfl.ch

- Duration: 9 months, extendable

en.title: Postdoctoral Researcher / Research Engineer
en.description:
Research Challenge

The Research Challenge: AI training costs are exploding, largely due to energy and bandwidth inefficiencies in current electrical datacenters.

Our group is developing a novel Optical Circuit Switched (OCS) architecture that drastically reduces power and latency.

We are looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher / Research Engineer with a background in Embedded Systems and Low-Level Programming to design the control logic that powers this new hybrid network.

Your code will directly enable the next generation of energy-efficient AI clusters.

Project Scope

• You will bridge the gap between custom optical hardware and standard AI software stacks .
• Unlike typical high-level networking roles, this project requires "bare-metal" intervention, programming the firmware and drivers that decide how and when data moves.

Role & Profile

You will lead the implementation of the system's data plane, applying embedded design principles to high-performance networking:

• SmartNIC & FPGA Programming: Implement real-time flow steering logic on devices like NVIDIA BlueField, AMD Pensando or similar.
• Driver Development: Develop and optimize Linux kernel modules and userspace drivers (DPDK) to manage flows.
• Hardware/Software Co-Design: Collaborate with optical physicists to translate physical layer constraints into efficient C/C++ control firmware.
• Evaluation: Benchmark the system against standard IP fabrics and publish results in top-tier conferences (SIGCOMM, NSDI, OSDI).

Requirements

We are looking for a candidate who is comfortable "looking under the hood" of the operating system. You do not need prior experience with optics.

• PhD/Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
• Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Linux Systems Programming .
• Experience with Embedded Linux and Kernel drivers.

Bonus Skills (Nice to have)

• Familiarity with Network Interface Cards (NICs) or packet processing (eBPF, XDP).
• Experience bringing up custom hardware boards.

What we offer

• A stimulating and international working environment
• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions – more information can be found on our website (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)
• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe.
• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

Contact

- Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered.
- You are asked to supply:
- Your CV
- A brief statement of interests
- A link to your code portfolio (GitHub/GitLab)
- For any further information, please contact: mustafa.yildirim@epfl.ch

Details

- Contract Start Date: 1st March 2026
- Activity Rate: 100%
- Contract Type: CDD
- Duration: 9 months, extendable

## Profile

The Structural Xploration Lab is seeking a new research collaborator with a PhD in building technology, preferably in the field of building materials and/or building envelope performance and/or building renovation. The candidate must be familiar with contemporary construction techniques and have an interest in 20th-century construction techniques or vernacular architecture. Experience in Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Building Information Modelling (BIM), Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or computer programming is a plus. A master's degree or professional experience in architecture is preferred but not required.

The employment rate varies between 80% and 100%, depending on the candidate's availability. This is a 9-month contract, renewable. The earliest start date is May 1st or as soon as possible.

## Missions

The main research activities will be related to the characterization and circular performance assessment of building envelopes in Europe, with a scope ranging from construction details and building archetypes to large-scale inference of building stocks. The project is embedded into a EU-Horizon project in collaboration with foreign industrial and research partners.

The candidate may also contribute to other research and teaching activities as well as to the supervision of architecture students at bachelor's and master's level.

## About us

The Structural Xploration Lab is a group of doctoral and postdoctoral researchers in architecture and civil engineering. It is known for its development of tools, design methods, large-scale analyses and built prototypes aimed at enabling the Architecture, Engineering and Construction (AEC) sector to adopt more circular load-bearing systems. SXL also contributes to teaching building technologies and circular practices to undergraduate, master's students and professionals in architecture and civil engineering. As a unit of EPFL's ENAC faculty and located in the Smart Living Lab in Fribourg (CH), SXL benefits from state-of-the-art research infrastructure and offers an inclusive, international and stimulating work environment.

- You are asked to supply your CV and a brief statement of interests.

en.title: Postdoctoral researcher in building technology
en.description:
Profile

The Structural Xploration Lab is seeking a new research collaborator with a PhD in building technology, preferably in the field of building materials and/or building envelope performance and/or building renovation. The candidate must be familiar with contemporary construction techniques and have an interest in 20th-century construction techniques or vernacular architecture. Experience in Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Building Information Modelling (BIM), Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or computer programming is a plus. A master's degree or professional experience in architecture is preferred but not required.

The employment rate varies between 80% and 100%, depending on the candidate's availability. This is a 9-month contract, renewable. The earliest start date is May 1st or as soon as possible.

Missions

The main research activities will be related to the characterization and circular performance assessment of building envelopes in Europe, with a scope ranging from construction details and building archetypes to large-scale inference of building stocks. The project is embedded into a EU-Horizon project in collaboration with foreign industrial and research partners.

The candidate may also contribute to other research and teaching activities as well as to the supervision of architecture students at bachelor's and master's level.

About us

The Structural Xploration Lab is a group of doctoral and postdoctoral researchers in architecture and civil engineering. It is known for its development of tools, design methods, large-scale analyses and built prototypes aimed at enabling the Architecture, Engineering and Construction (AEC) sector to adopt more circular load-bearing systems. SXL also contributes to teaching building technologies and circular practices to undergraduate, master's students and professionals in architecture and civil engineering. As a unit of EPFL's ENAC faculty and located in the Smart Living Lab in Fribourg (CH), SXL benefits from state-of-the-art research infrastructure and offers an inclusive, international and stimulating work environment.

Application

- Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered.
- You are asked to supply your CV and a brief statement of interests.

For any further information, please contact teresa.messina@epfl.ch.

it.title: Ricercatore post-dottorato in tecnologia edilizia
it.description:
Profilo

Il Laboratorio di Xplorazione Strutturale è alla ricerca di un nuovo collaboratore di ricerca con un dottorato in tecnologia edilizia, preferibilmente nel campo dei materiali da costruzione e/o delle prestazioni dell'involucro edilizio e/o della ristrutturazione edilizia. Il candidato deve essere familiare con le tecniche di costruzione contemporanee e avere un interesse per le tecniche di costruzione del XX secolo o per l'architettura vernacolare. L'esperienza in Valutazione del Ciclo di Vita (LCA), Modello di Informazione Edilizia (BIM), Sistemi Informativi Geografici (GIS) o programmazione informatica è un vantaggio. È preferita ma non obbligatoria una laurea magistrale o esperienza professionale in architettura.

Il tasso di occupazione varia tra l'80% e il 100%, a seconda della disponibilità del candidato. Questo è un contratto di 9 mesi, rinnovabile. La data di inizio più anticipata è il 1° maggio o il prima possibile.

Missioni

Le principali attività di ricerca saranno relative alla caratterizzazione e alla valutazione delle prestazioni circolari degli involucri edilizi in Europa, con un ambito che va dai dettagli costruttivi e archetipi edilizi all'inferenza su larga scala degli stock edilizi. Il progetto è inserito in un progetto EU-Horizon in collaborazione con partner industriali e di ricerca stranieri.

Il candidato potrà anche contribuire ad altre attività di ricerca e insegnamento, nonché alla supervisione di studenti di architettura a livello di laurea e laurea magistrale.

Chi siamo

Il Laboratorio di Xplorazione Strutturale è un gruppo di ricercatori dottorali e post-dottorali in architettura e ingegneria civile. È noto per lo sviluppo di strumenti, metodi di design, analisi su larga scala e prototipi costruiti volti a consentire al settore Architettura, Ingegneria e Costruzione (AEC) di adottare sistemi portanti più circolari. SXL contribuisce anche all'insegnamento delle tecnologie edilizie e delle pratiche circolari a studenti universitari, studenti di laurea magistrale e professionisti in architettura e ingegneria civile. Come unità della facoltà ENAC dell'EPFL e situata nel Smart Living Lab a Friburgo (CH), SXL beneficia di un'infrastruttura di ricerca all'avanguardia e offre un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, internazionale e stimolante.

Aufgaben

Die Hauptforschungsaktivitäten beziehen sich auf die Charakterisierung und die zirkuläre Leistungsbewertung von Gebäudehüllen in Europa, mit einem Umfang, der von Konstruktionsdetails und Gebäude-Archetypen bis hin zu großflächigen Inferenz von Gebäudevorräten reicht. Le Laboratoire d'Exploration Structurale recherche un nouveau collaborateur de recherche titulaire d'un doctorat en technologie de construction, de préférence dans le domaine des matériaux de construction et/ou des performances des enveloppes de bâtiment et/ou de la rénovation de bâtiments. Le candidat doit être familier avec les techniques de construction contemporaines et avoir un intérêt pour les techniques de construction du XXe siècle ou l'architecture vernaculaire. Une expérience en Évaluation du Cycle de Vie (ACV), Modélisation de l'Information du Bâtiment (BIM), Systèmes d'Information Géographique (SIG) ou programmation informatique est un plus. Un diplôme de master ou une expérience professionnelle en architecture est préférée mais non obligatoire.

Le taux d'emploi varie entre 80 % et 100 %, en fonction de la disponibilité du candidat. Il s'agit d'un contrat de 9 mois, renouvelable. La date de début la plus précoce est le 1er mai ou dès que possible.

Missions

Les principales activités de recherche seront liées à la caractérisation et à l'évaluation des performances circulaires des enveloppes de bâtiment en Europe, avec un champ d'application allant des détails de construction et des archétypes de bâtiments à l'inférence à grande échelle des stocks de bâtiments. Le projet est intégré dans un projet EU-Horizon en collaboration avec des partenaires industriels et de recherche étrangers.

Le Laboratoire d'Exploration Structurale est un groupe de chercheurs doctorants et postdoctorants en architecture et en génie civil. Il est connu pour le développement d'outils, de méthodes de conception, d'analyses à grande échelle et de prototypes construits visant à permettre au secteur de l'Architecture, de l'Ingénierie et de la Construction (AEC) d'adopter des systèmes portants plus circulaires. SXL contribue également à l'enseignement des technologies de construction et des pratiques circulaires aux étudiants de premier cycle, aux étudiants de master et aux professionnels en architecture et en génie civil. Der Kandidat kann auch zu anderen Forschungs- und Lehraktivitäten sowie zur Betreuung von Architekturstudenten auf Bachelor- und Master-Niveau beitragen. Über uns Das Structural Xploration Lab ist eine Gruppe von Doktoranden und Postdoktoranden in Architektur und Bauingenieurwesen.

Sie ist bekannt für ihre Entwicklung von Werkzeugen, Designmethoden, großformatigen Analysen und gebauten Prototypen, die es dem Sektor Architektur, Ingenieurwesen und Bauwesen (AEC) ermöglichen, kreisförmigere Tragsysteme zu übernehmen. SXL trägt auch dazu bei, Gebäudetechnologien und kreisförmige Praktiken für Studierende, Masterstudenten und Fachleute in Architektur und Bauingenieurwesen zu unterrichten.

Als Einheit der ENAC-Fakultät der EPFL im Smart Living Lab in Freiburg (CH) profitiert SXL von der hochmodernen Forschungsinfrastruktur und bietet ein integratives, internationales und stimulierendes Arbeitsumfeld. ## Description

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

## The Position

Solution Architect - DIA R&D

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions. You will develop and maintain the product's technology roadmap, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

## The Opportunity

- Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

- Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

- Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

- Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.

- Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.

- Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Contributes minimally but effectively to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

## Who you are

### Education / Experience

- Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a specific solution context.

- Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes.

### Technical Skills

- General and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas.

- Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for solutions and interfaces.

- Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions.

- Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for the solution, including conducting vendor assessments.

### Additional Qualifications

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain difficult or sensitive information and successfully build consensus.

- Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improve existing solutions, and manage technical debt.

it.title: Solution Architect - DIA R&D
it.description:
Description

In Roche puoi presentarti come sei, valorizzato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e connessioni autentiche, dove sei valorizzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. Questo è il nostro modo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso alle cure oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La Posizione

Solution Architect - DIA R&D

Lo Solution Architect si concentra sulla progettazione di soluzioni orientate al business, basate su standard e pronte per il futuro all’interno di un contesto di soluzione specifico. In questo ruolo, progetterai soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti del prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali, gestendo al contempo i requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e le funzioni di fitness. Svilupperai e manterrai la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto, fornirai supervisione tecnica ai team di prodotto e valuterai nuove tecnologie per migliorare continuamente le soluzioni esistenti e gestire il debito tecnico.

L'Opportunità

- Scope / (Content Leadership): Progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti del prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali all’interno di un contesto di soluzione specifico. Gestisce i Requisiti Non Funzionali (NFR) e le funzioni di fitness. Documenta ed evolve l’architettura durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per la governance.

- Responsabilità / Risoluzione dei Problemi: Risolve problemi complessi adottando una nuova prospettiva sulle soluzioni esistenti e esercitando giudizio basato sull’analisi di molteplici fonti di informazione. Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il panorama attuale della soluzione. Valuta e consulenza sugli impatti e le dipendenze delle iniziative su capacità, rischi e landscape applicativi. Crea Modelli di Dati Concettuali e Logici, Taxonomie e Ontologie per la soluzione e le sue interfacce. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, pattern, e assicura che gli Archivi delle Decisioni Architettoniche (ADR) siano debitamente registrati.

- Gestione Stakeholder: Spiega informazioni difficili o sensibili in modo chiaro e lavora attivamente per costruire consenso tra gli stakeholder. Promuove la condivisione e lo scambio di informazioni sulla soluzione.

- Impatto / Strategia: Sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto. Fornisce supervisione tecnica, orientamento e consulenza su tecnologie specifiche per i team di prodotto. Migliora le soluzioni esistenti, gestisce il debito tecnico e ricerca, valuta, pilota e promuove l’adozione di nuove tecnologie. Identifica opportunità per aumentare il valore e migliorare i processi aziendali.

- Complessità / (Dimensione del Prodotto): Opera principalmente all’interno di un contesto di soluzione definito.

- Capacità aziendali / tecniche: Applica conoscenze generali e approfondite in uno o due ambiti tecnologici. Contribuisce in modo minimo ma efficace allo sviluppo e al mentoring delle pratiche di architettura.

Chi sei

Formazione / Esperienza

- Esperienza dimostrata nella progettazione di soluzioni orientate al business, basate su standard e pronte per il futuro all’interno di un contesto di soluzione specifico.

- Esperienza nel mantenere la visione, la roadmap e il panorama attuale delle soluzioni tecniche, e nel valutare gli impatti delle iniziative su rischi e landscape applicativi.

Competenze Tecniche

- Conoscenza generale e approfondita in uno o due ambiti tecnologici.

- Competenza nella creazione di Modelli di Dati Concettuali e Logici, Taxonomie e Ontologie per soluzioni e interfacce.

- Capacità di definire e guidare architetture di riferimento, pattern, NFR e funzioni di fitness.

- Forte capacità di guidare le tendenze tecnologiche esterne e valutare la fattibilità per la soluzione, inclusa la valutazione dei fornitori.

Qualifiche Aggiuntive

- Forti capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con abilità di spiegare informazioni difficili o sensibili e di costruire con successo consenso.

- Mentalità proattiva per identificare opportunità di miglioramento del valore e dei processi aziendali, migliorare le soluzioni esistenti e gestire il debito tecnico.

de.title: Solution Architect - DIA R&D
de.description:
Beschreibung

Bei Roche kannst du du selbst sein, geschätzt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die du mitbringst. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen du wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert wirst, so wie du bist. Das ermöglicht dir, sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich zu gedeihen. So wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, sie stoppen und heilen sowie sicherstellen, dass heute und für kommende Generationen jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position

Solution Architect - DIA R&D

Der Solution Architect konzentriert sich auf die Gestaltung geschäftsorientierter, standardsbasierter und zukunftsfähiger Lösungen innerhalb eines spezifischen Lösungskontexts. In dieser Rolle entwirfst du Lösungen, die Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards erfüllen, während du nicht-funktionale Anforderungen (NFRs) und Fitness-Funktionen managst. Du entwickelst und pflegst die technologische Roadmap des Produkts, überwachst die technischen Aspekte der Produktteams und evaluierst neue Technologien, um bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich zu verbessern und technische Schulden zu verwalten.

Die Chance

- Umfang / (Content Leadership): Entwirft Lösungen, die Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards innerhalb eines spezifischen Lösungskontexts erfüllen. Managt nicht-funktionale Anforderungen (NFR) und Fitness-Funktionen. Dokumentiert und entwickelt die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus weiter und stimmt sich mit der Architektur-Community zur Governance ab.

- Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Löst komplexe Probleme, indem er eine neue Perspektive auf bestehende Lösungen einnimmt und Urteilsvermögen basierend auf der Analyse verschiedener Informationsquellen anwendet. Bewahrt die Vision, Roadmap und den aktuellen Stand der Lösung. Bewertet und berät zu den Auswirkungen und Abhängigkeiten von Initiativen auf Fähigkeiten, Risiken und Anwendungslandschaften. Erstellt konzeptionelle und logische Datenmodelle, Taxonomien und Ontologien für die Lösung und ihre Schnittstellen. Definiert und treibt Referenzarchitekturen, Patterns und stellt sicher, dass Architekturentscheidungsdokumente (ADRs) ordnungsgemäß dokumentiert werden.

- Stakeholder-Management: Erklärt schwierige oder sensible Informationen klar und arbeitet aktiv daran, Konsens unter den Stakeholdern zu schaffen. Fördert den Informationsaustausch und die Kommunikation über die Lösung.

- Einfluss / Strategie: Entwickelt und pflegt die technologische Roadmap des Produkts. Bietet technische Aufsicht, Beratung und Guidance zu spezifischen Technologien für die Produktteams. Verbessert bestehende Lösungen, verwaltet technische Schulden und erforscht, bewertet, pilotiert und fördert die Einführung neuer Technologien. Identifiziert Chancen zur Wertsteigerung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen.

- Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Arbeitet hauptsächlich innerhalb eines definierten Lösungskontexts.

- Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Wendet allgemeines und tiefgehendes Wissen in ein oder zwei Technologiebereichen an. Trägt minimal, aber effektiv zur Entwicklung und Mentoring von Architekturpraktiken bei.

Wer du bist

Ausbildung / Erfahrung

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Gestaltung geschäftsorientierter, standardsbasierter und zukunftsfähiger Lösungen innerhalb eines spezifischen Lösungskontexts.

- Erfahrung in der Pflege der Vision, Roadmap und des aktuellen Landschaftsbildes technischer Lösungen sowie in der Bewertung der Auswirkungen von Initiativen auf Risiken und Anwendungslandschaften.

Technische Fähigkeiten

- Allgemeines und tiefgehendes Wissen in ein oder zwei Technologiebereichen.

- Kompetenz in der Erstellung konzeptioneller und logischer Datenmodelle, Taxonomien und Ontologien für Lösungen und Schnittstellen.

- Fähigkeit, Referenzarchitekturen, Patterns, NFRs und Fitness-Funktionen zu definieren und voranzutreiben.

- Starke Fähigkeit, externe Technologietrends zu steuern und die Machbarkeit für die Lösung zu bewerten, inklusive Vendor-Bewertungen.

Zusätzliche Qualifikationen

- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, schwierige oder sensible Informationen klar zu erklären und erfolgreich Konsens zu schaffen.

- Proaktive Denkweise, um Chancen zur Wertsteigerung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen zu erkennen, bestehende Lösungen zu verbessern und technische Schulden zu managen.

fr.title: Architecte de Solutions - DIA R&D
fr.description:
Description

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter tel que vous êtes, valorisé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l’expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et des connexions authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour ce que vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies, en assurant à chacun l’accès aux soins aujourd’hui et pour les générations futures. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

Le Poste

Solution Architect - DIA R&D

L’Architecte de Solutions se concentre sur la conception de solutions orientées métier, basées sur des standards et prêtes pour l’avenir, dans un contexte de solution spécifique. Dans ce rôle, vous concevrez des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités de l’entreprise et aux standards d’entreprise, tout en gérant les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les fonctions de fitness. Vous développerez et maintiendrez la feuille de route technologique du produit, fournirez une supervision technique aux équipes produit et évaluerez de nouvelles technologies pour améliorer en continu les solutions existantes et gérer la dette technique.

L’Opportunité

- Portée / (Leadership de contenu) : Conçoit des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités de l’entreprise et aux standards d’entreprise dans un contexte de solution spécifique. Gère les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les fonctions de fitness. Documente et fait évoluer l’architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit et s’aligne avec la communauté d’architecture pour la gouvernance.

- Responsabilité / Résolution de problèmes : Résout des problèmes complexes en adoptant une nouvelle perspective sur les solutions existantes et en exerçant un jugement basé sur l’analyse de multiples sources d’informations. Maintient la vision, la feuille de route et le paysage actuel de la solution. Évalue et conseille sur les impacts et dépendances des initiatives sur les capacités, les risques et le paysage applicatif. Crée des modèles de données conceptuels et logiques, des taxonomies et des ontologies pour la solution et ses interfaces. Définit et pilote des architectures de référence, des patterns, et veille à ce que les Records de Décision d’Architecture (ADR) soient correctement enregistrés.

- Gestion des parties prenantes : Explique clairement des informations difficiles ou sensibles et travaille activement à construire un consensus parmi les parties prenantes. Favorise le partage d’informations et l’échange autour de la solution.

- Impact / Stratégie : Développe et maintient la feuille de route technologique du produit. Fournit une supervision technique, des conseils et une orientation sur des technologies spécifiques pour les équipes produit. Améliore les solutions existantes, gère la dette technique et recherche, évalue, pilote et promeut l’adoption de nouvelles technologies. Identifie des opportunités pour augmenter la valeur et améliorer les processus métier.

- Complexité / (Taille du produit) : Opère principalement dans un contexte de solution défini.

- Capacité métier / technique : Applique des connaissances générales et approfondies dans un ou deux domaines technologiques. Contribue de manière minimale mais efficace au développement et au mentorat des pratiques d’architecture.

Qui vous êtes

Formation / Expérience

- Expérience démontrée dans la conception de solutions orientées métier, basées sur des standards et prêtes pour l’avenir, dans un contexte de solution spécifique.

- Expérience dans la gestion de la vision, de la feuille de route et du paysage actuel des solutions techniques, ainsi que dans l’évaluation des impacts des initiatives sur les risques et les paysages applicatifs.

Compétences Techniques

- Connaissance générale et approfondie dans un ou deux domaines technologiques.

- Maîtrise de la création de modèles de données conceptuels et logiques, de taxonomies et d’ontologies pour des solutions et interfaces.

- Capacité à définir et à piloter des architectures de référence, des patterns, des NFR et des fonctions de fitness.

- Forte capacité à suivre les tendances technologiques externes et à évaluer la faisabilité pour la solution, y compris l’évaluation des fournisseurs.

Qualifications Supplémentaires

- Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d’expliquer des informations difficiles ou sensibles et de construire avec succès un consensus.

- Esprit proactif pour identifier des opportunités d’amélioration de la valeur et des processus métier, améliorer les solutions existantes et gérer la dette technique.

Bewahrt die Vision, die Roadmap und die aktuelle Landschaft für die Lösung. Identifiziert Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Wert und Geschäftsprozessen. - Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Operiert in erster Linie innerhalb eines definierten Lösungskontexts.

Conserve la vision, la feuille de route et le paysage actuel de la solution. - Impact/Stratégie : Concevoir et maintenir la feuille de route technologique du produit. Fournit une supervision technique, des conseils et des consultations sur des technologies spécifiques pour les équipes de produits. Améliore les solutions existantes, gère la dette technique et recherche, évalue, pilote et stimule l'adoption de nouvelles technologies.

- Capacités d'affaires / techniques : Applique des connaissances générales et approfondies dans un ou deux domaines technologiques. Contribue de façon minimale mais efficace au développement et au mentorat des pratiques d'architecture. Qui vous êtes Éducation / expérience - Expérience démontrée de conception de solutions axées sur les affaires, fondées sur des normes, prêtes à l'avenir dans un contexte de solution spécifique. - Expérience de maintien de la vision, de la feuille de route et du paysage actuel pour des solutions techniques, et d'évaluation des impacts des initiatives sur les paysages à risque et d'application.

Compétences techniques - Connaissances générales et approfondies dans un ou deux domaines technologiques. - Compétences en création de modèles de données conceptuelles et logiques, de taxonomies et d'études d'interfaces et de solutions. - Capacité de définir et de piloter des architectures de référence, des modèles, des RNF et des fonctions de conditionnement physique. - Capacité solide de stimuler les tendances technologiques externes et d'évaluer la faisabilité de la solution, y compris la réalisation d'évaluations des fournisseurs.

Qualifications supplémentaires - Compétences en communication et en gestion des intervenants solides, avec la capacité d'expliquer des renseignements difficiles ou sensibles et de parvenir à un consensus. - L'état d'esprit proactif pour cerner les occasions d'améliorer la valeur et les processus opérationnels, d'améliorer les solutions existantes et de gérer la dette technique.

Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Entra a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La soluzione di posizionamento Architetto - DIA R&D La soluzione Architetto si concentra sulla progettazione di soluzioni basate su business, standard e future-ready in un contesto specifico di soluzione. In questo ruolo, si progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti dei prodotti, priorità aziendali e standard aziendali, mentre la gestione di requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e funzioni di fitness. Si svilupperà e mantenere la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto, fornire la supervisione tecnica ai team di prodotti, e valutare le nuove tecnologie per migliorare continuamente le soluzioni esistenti e gestire il debito tecnico.

Opportunità - Scope / (Content Leadership): Progetta soluzioni che soddisfino i requisiti dei prodotti, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali all'interno di uno specifico contesto di soluzione. Gestisce requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e funzioni di fitness. Documenti e evolve l'architettura durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per la governance. - Responsabilità / soluzione dei problemi: risolve i problemi complessi prendendo una nuova prospettiva sulle soluzioni esistenti e esercitando giudizio basato sull'analisi di più fonti di informazione.

Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il panorama attuale della soluzione. Valuta e consulta gli impatti e le dipendenze delle iniziative sulle capacità, il rischio e il paesaggio applicativo. Crea modelli di dati concettuali e logici, Taxenomics e Ontologies per la soluzione e le sue interfacce. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, modelli e garantisce che siano registrati adeguatamente Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). - Gestione delle parti interessate: illustra informazioni difficili o sensibili chiaramente e attivamente lavora per costruire il consenso tra le parti interessate.

Guida la condivisione delle informazioni e lo scambio sulla soluzione. - Impact/Strategy: Sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto. Fornisce supervisione tecnica, orientamento e consultazione su tecnologie specifiche per team di prodotti. Migliora le soluzioni esistenti, gestisce il debito tecnico e ricerca, valuta, pilota e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie. Identifica le opportunità di migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali. - Complessità / (Dimensioni del prodotto): funziona principalmente all'interno di un contesto definito di soluzione.

- Business / Technical abilità: Applica conoscenze generali e approfondite in uno o due settori tecnologici. Contribuisce in modo minimale ma efficace allo sviluppo delle pratiche di architettura e di mentoring. Chi sei Istruzione / esperienza - esperienza dimostrativa che progetta soluzioni basate su business, basate su standard, future-ready in un contesto specifico di soluzione. - esperienza mantenendo la visione, roadmap, e paesaggio attuale per soluzioni tecniche, e valutando l'impatto delle iniziative sui paesaggi di rischio e di applicazione.

Capacità tecniche - Conoscenze generali e approfondite in uno o due settori tecnologici. - Professionalità nella creazione di modelli di dati concettuali e logici, di Taxonomie e di Ontologies per soluzioni e interfacce. - Capacità di definire e guidare architetture di riferimento, modelli, NFR e funzioni di fitness. - Capacità di guidare tendenze tecnologiche esterne e valutare la fattibilità della soluzione, comprese valutazioni dei fornitori.

Qualificazioni aggiuntive - Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di spiegare informazioni difficili o sensibili e costruire con successo il consenso. - Mindset proattivo per individuare opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali, migliorare le soluzioni esistenti e gestire il debito tecnico.

## About Bachem

Bachem is a leading, innovation-driven company specializing in the development and manufacture of peptides and oligonucleotides. With over 50 years of experience and expertise Bachem provides products for research, clinical development and commercial application to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide and offers a comprehensive range of services. Bachem operates internationally with headquarters in Switzerland and locations in Europe, the US and Asia. The company is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange. For further information, see www.bachem.com.

## Position

As Automation Engineer / Project Engineer for the Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab 100% (m/w/d), you will play a central role in building, operating, and advancing our laboratory environment for digital manufacturing solutions. You will combine expertise in process automation, simulation, and lab infrastructure to enable engineers, data scientists, and developers to design, test, and deploy innovative solutions.

With a strong focus on PCS7-based automation systems, SIMIT simulations, and lab infrastructure, you will act as a technical allrounder bridging automation, IT/OT development systems, and user enablement. Your work will directly support experimentation, prototyping, and scaling of digital and automation solutions across TechOps and manufacturing.

## Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and maintain the Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab infrastructure, including automation systems, virtualized environments, and network setups
- Develop, configure, and support Siemens PCS7 systems (incl. WinCC, Simatic Batch) for lab and pilot environments
- Build and maintain simulation capabilities and digital twins using SIMIT, enabling virtual commissioning, testing, and training scenarios
- Administer and operate lab IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, systems, and network components
- Integrate controllers, field devices, and lab equipment into cohesive automation and data environments
- Provide and maintain internal tools, templates, and automation libraries for users of the lab
- Support users (engineers, data scientists) in utilizing lab systems for experiments, testing, and troubleshooting
- Participate in automation and digitalization projects, from requirements gathering to prototyping and implementation
- Maintain system documentation, ensure configuration management, and support testing activities where applicable
- Identify opportunities to improve the lab environment and introduce new technologies and best practices

## Requirements

- University degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- Hands-on experience with process control systems, ideally Siemens PCS7, WinCC, and Simatic Batch, as well as simulation tools such as SIMIT or similar platforms
- Solid understanding of automation hardware, PLCs, controllers, field instrumentation, system integration, and industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus)
- Practical knowledge of IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, Windows administration, TCP/IP networking, virtual environments (e.g., VMware, Proxmox), and network segmentation in lab setups
- Exposure to data systems (e.g., historians, MES, analytics platforms), their integration with automation systems, and experience in virtual commissioning and digital twin approaches
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work across disciplines, act as a technical allrounder, and translate user needs into practical technical solutions
- Dedicated, self-driven, structured, and collaborative personality with a hands-on mindset; solid knowledge of German is considered a strong plus

## What we offer

## QA Shopfloor Manager (f/m/d)

To advance our vision of a shopfloor-integrated QA function, we are seeking a QA Shopfloor Manager (f/m/d) who brings both expertise and a collaborative mindset to our dynamic and motivated team. The ideal candidate will not only complement our existing capabilities but also contribute fresh perspectives and drive continuous improvement in our operational quality practices.

### Your tasks

- Provide proactive quality presence on the shopfloor to ensure uninterrupted, compliant manufacturing operations and meeting adherence to schedule
- Act as the primary QA point of contact for production teams enabling fast, informed decision-making and real-time issue resolution
- Ensure seamless QA support by coordinating across QA functions to deliver consistent, and efficient quality support to manufacturing and support preparing quality rated answers for customer requests
- Enforce strict adherence to internal procedures and GxP requirements supporting right-first-time execution and minimizing delays
- Support investigations into deviations and non-conformances, ensuring robust root cause analysis, effective CAPA implementation, and timely closure
- Accelerate by facilitating rapid assessments and ensuring high-quality documentation of quality-related matters
- Represent QA in daily and weekly shop floor meetings, addressing quality risks and promoting a solutions-oriented mindset
- Lead and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality performance, reduce waste, and increase operational efficiency
- Foster a culture of ownership and accountability on the shopfloor, where quality, accountability, and continuous improvement is seen as an enabler

### Your profile

- University degree (Bachelor/Master) in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Natural Sciences, or a comparable scientific or technical discipline, with relevant experience in the field
- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in API manufacturing, preferably within a CDMO environment
- Demonstrated expertise in quality assurance, with direct exposure to manufacturing operations
- Strong working knowledge of GMP, regulatory requirements, and ALCOA+ principles
- High level of interest in manufacturing processes and operational QA topics, with a mindset geared toward best practices and modern technologies
- Familiarity with quality systems and documentation processes, including deviation handling, CAPA, and change control
- Experience with or willingness to develop skills in Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies
- Proficient in both written and spoken German and English

### Our offer

- A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities
- Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction
- Employee development through numerous internal and external training opportunities
- 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG as well as option for extra-mandatory pension provision with our Pension Plan Plus
- Access to the Swibeco benefits platform with discounts from external partners
- Fresh, healthy and varied food in our staff restaurant
- A wide range of free sports activities on the Bachem Campus

Would you like to drive innovation together with us?

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our exciting work environment at our location in Bubendorf!

it.description:
Su Bachem

Bachem è un'azienda leader e orientata all'innovazione specializzata nello sviluppo e nella produzione di peptidi e oligonucleotidi. Con oltre 50 anni di esperienza e competenza, Bachem fornisce prodotti per la ricerca, lo sviluppo clinico e l'applicazione commerciale a società farmaceutiche e biotecnologiche in tutto il mondo, offrendo una gamma completa di servizi. Bachem opera a livello internazionale con sede principale in Svizzera e sedi in Europa, negli Stati Uniti e in Asia. L'azienda è quotata alla SIX Swiss Exchange. Per ulteriori informazioni, visita www.bachem.com.

Posizione

In qualità di Ingegnere dell'automazione / Ingegnere di progetto per il Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab 100% (m/f/d), rivestirai un ruolo centrale nella costruzione, gestione e sviluppo del nostro laboratorio per soluzioni di produzione digitale. Unirai competenze in automazione di processo, simulazione e infrastruttura di laboratorio per consentire a ingegneri, data scientist e sviluppatori di progettare, testare e implementare soluzioni innovative.

Con un focus particolare su sistemi di automazione basati su PCS7, simulazioni SIMIT e infrastrutture di laboratorio, agirai come un tecnico versatile che collega automazione, sistemi di sviluppo IT/OT e abilitazione degli utenti. Il tuo lavoro supporterà direttamente sperimentazione, prototipazione e scalabilità di soluzioni digitali e di automazione nell'ambito di TechOps e produzione.

Responsabilità

- Progettare, implementare e mantenere l'infrastruttura del Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab, inclusi sistemi di automazione, ambienti virtualizzati e configurazioni di rete
- Sviluppare, configurare e supportare sistemi Siemens PCS7 (incl. WinCC, Simatic Batch) per ambienti di laboratorio e pilota
- Costruire e mantenere capacità di simulazione e gemelli digitali utilizzando SIMIT, abilitando commissioning virtuale, test e scenari di formazione
- Amministrare e gestire infrastrutture IT/OT di laboratorio, inclusi virtualizzazione, sistemi e componenti di rete
- Integrare controllori, dispositivi di campo e attrezzature di laboratorio in ambienti di automazione e dati coerenti
- Fornire e mantenere strumenti interni, modelli e librerie di automazione per gli utenti del laboratorio
- Supportare gli utenti (ingegneri, data scientist) nell'utilizzo dei sistemi di laboratorio per esperimenti, test e risoluzione di problemi
- Partecipare a progetti di automazione e digitalizzazione, dalla raccolta dei requisiti alla prototipazione e implementazione
- Mantenere la documentazione dei sistemi, garantire la gestione delle configurazioni e supportare le attività di test, ove applicabile
- Identificare opportunità per migliorare l'ambiente di laboratorio e introdurre nuove tecnologie e best practice

Requisiti

- Laurea in Ingegneria dell'automazione, Ingegneria elettrica, Informatica o un campo tecnico correlato
- Esperienza pratica con sistemi di controllo di processo, idealmente Siemens PCS7, WinCC e Simatic Batch, nonché strumenti di simulazione come SIMIT o piattaforme simili
- Conoscenza approfondita di hardware di automazione, PLC, controllori, strumentazione di campo, integrazione di sistemi e protocolli di comunicazione industriale (ad esempio OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus)
- Conoscenza pratica di infrastrutture IT/OT, inclusa virtualizzazione, amministrazione di Windows, networking TCP/IP, ambienti virtuali (ad esempio VMware, Proxmox) e segmentazione di rete in ambienti di laboratorio
- Esperienza con sistemi di dati (ad esempio historian, MES, piattaforme di analisi), loro integrazione con sistemi di automazione e approcci di commissioning virtuale e gemelli digitali
- Forti capacità di risoluzione dei problemi con la capacità di lavorare in modo interdisciplinare, agire come tecnico versatile e tradurre le esigenze degli utenti in soluzioni tecniche pratiche
- Personalità dedicata, autonoma, strutturata e collaborativa con mentalità pratica; la conoscenza solida del tedesco è considerata un vantaggio

Cosa offriamo

- Opportunità di sviluppo professionale e formazione continua
- Condizioni di lavoro moderne e flessibili

- Possibilità di contribuire attivamente a progetti all'avanguardia nel settore farmaceutico e biotecnologico

Bachem ist ein führendes, innovationsgetriebenes Unternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung und Herstellung von Peptiden und Oligonukleotiden spezialisiert hat. Mit über 50 Jahren Erfahrung und Expertise bietet Bachem Produkte für Forschung, klinische Entwicklung und kommerzielle Anwendung für Pharma- und Biotechnologieunternehmen weltweit an und bietet ein umfassendes Dienstleistungsspektrum. Bachem ist international tätig mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz und Standorten in Europa, den USA und Asien. Das Unternehmen ist an der SIX Swiss Exchange gelistet. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter www.bachem.com.

Position

Als Automatisierungsingenieur / Projektingenieur für das Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab 100% (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau, Betrieb und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Laborumgebung für digitale Fertigungslösungen. À propos de Bachem

Bachem est une entreprise leader et axée sur l'innovation, spécialisée dans le développement et la fabrication de peptides et d'oligonucléotides. Fort de plus de 50 ans d'expérience et d'expertise, Bachem fournit des produits pour la recherche, le développement clinique et l'application commerciale à des entreprises pharmaceutiques et biotechnologiques du monde entier, tout en offrant une gamme complète de services. Bachem opère à l'international avec son siège social en Suisse et des sites en Europe, aux États-Unis et en Asie. L'entreprise est cotée à la SIX Swiss Exchange. Pour plus d'informations, consultez le site www.bachem.com.

Poste

En tant qu'ingénieur en automatisation / ingénieur de projet pour le Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab 100% (m/f/d), vous jouerez un rôle central dans la construction, l'exploitation et le développement de notre environnement de laboratoire dédié aux solutions de fabrication numérique. Vous combinerez votre expertise en automatisation des processus, en simulation et en infrastructure de laboratoire pour permettre aux ingénieurs, aux data scientists et aux développeurs de concevoir, tester et déployer des solutions innovantes.

QA Shopfloor Manager (f/m/d)

To advance our vision of a shopfloor-integrated QA function, we are seeking a QA Shopfloor Manager (f/m/d) who brings both expertise and a collaborative mindset to our dynamic and motivated team. The ideal candidate will not only complement our existing capabilities but also contribute fresh perspectives and drive continuous improvement in our operational quality practices.

Your tasks

- Provide proactive quality presence on the shopfloor to ensure uninterrupted, compliant manufacturing operations and meeting adherence to schedule
- Act as the primary QA point of contact for production teams enabling fast, informed decision-making and real-time issue resolution
- Ensure seamless QA support by coordinating across QA functions to deliver consistent, and efficient quality support to manufacturing and support preparing quality rated answers for customer requests
- Enforce strict adherence to internal procedures and GxP requirements supporting right-first-time execution and minimizing delays
- Support investigations into deviations and non-conformances, ensuring robust root cause analysis, effective CAPA implementation, and timely closure
- Accelerate by facilitating rapid assessments and ensuring high-quality documentation of quality-related matters
- Represent QA in daily and weekly shop floor meetings, addressing quality risks and promoting a solutions-oriented mindset
- Lead and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality performance, reduce waste, and increase operational efficiency

- Familiarity with quality systems and documentation processes, including deviation handling, CAPA, and change control

- Erstellung und Überarbeitung von GMP Dokumenten (z.B. Analysevorschriften, SOP’s)

- Kenntnisse im Bereich GC/GCMS und IC von Vorteil
- Solide Kenntnisse üblicher IT-Applikationen, z.B. LIMS/LES, CDS (z.B. Chromeleon), SAP, sowie Softwareaffinität

- Zuverlässige Persönlichkeit mit Begeisterung für Verantwortung und Eigeninitiative
- Qualitätsbewusste, exakte und dienstleistungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Offenheit für Innovationen und Veränderungen

de.title: Lab Technician QC - Late Phase 100% (a) befristet 12 Monate
de.description:
Beschreibung

Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften.

Zur Verstärkung unseres GC/IC-Teams in der Abteilung QC Late Phase suchen wir eine(n) erfahrene(n) Lab Technician für die GC/IC-Analytik (12 Monate befristet)

Als engagierte und motivierte Persönlichkeit sind Sie Teil unserer anspruchsvollen Freigabeanalytik. Es erwarten Sie vielfältige Aufgaben und Fragestellungen in einem dynamischen und spannenden Umfeld. Dabei verantworten Sie im Schwerpunkt die Durchführung von Freigabeanalysen unserer TIDES-Wirkstoffe unter GMP.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Eigenständige Durchführung, Auswertung und Dokumentation von Freigabeanalysen im Bereich Gaschromatographie (GC) und Ionenchromatographie (IC)
- Review und Approval von Freigabeanalysen
- Entwicklung, Validierung und Life Cycle Management von GC und IC Analysemethoden
- Erstellung und Überarbeitung von GMP Dokumenten (z.B. Analysevorschriften, SOP’s)
- Übernahme von Verantwortlichkeiten in der Laborumgebung (u.a. bei der Planung der Routineanalytik, Troubleshooting)
- Pflege der Stammdaten / Logbucheinträge im LIMS
- Unterstützung bei der Analytischen Instrument- und Systemqualifizierung gemäss geltender GMP-Richtlinien und Life Cycle Management der analytischen Geräte
- Aktive Teilnahme an Massnahmen zur Optimierung und Verbesserung von QC-Prozessen

Ihr Profil

- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Chemielaborant/in, Fachrichtung Analytik
- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Umfeld chromatographischer GMP-Analytik
- Kenntnisse im Bereich GC/GCMS und IC von Vorteil
- Solide Kenntnisse üblicher IT-Applikationen, z.B. LIMS/LES, CDS (z.B. Chromeleon), SAP, sowie Softwareaffinität
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Zuverlässige Persönlichkeit mit Begeisterung für Verantwortung und Eigeninitiative
- Qualitätsbewusste, exakte und dienstleistungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Offenheit für Innovationen und Veränderungen

Unser Angebot

- Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- Mitarbeiterförderung durch zahlreiche interne und externe Weiterbildungsangebote
- 60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan
- Zugang zur Vorteilsplattform Swibeco mit Rabatten bei externen Partnern
- Frisches, gesundes und vielfältiges Essen in unserem Personalrestaurant
- Vielfältige kostenlose Sportaktivitäten auf dem Bachem Campus

it.title: Tecnico di laboratorio QC - Fase avanzata 100% (a) contratto a tempo determinato 12 mesi
it.description:
Descrizione

Per promuovere la nostra crescita organica continua, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati.

Per rafforzare il nostro team GC/IC nel reparto QC Fase Avanzata, cerchiamo un Tecnico di laboratorio esperto per l'analisi GC/IC (contratto a tempo determinato di 12 mesi).

Come persona impegnata e motivata, farai parte della nostra impegnativa analisi di rilascio. Ti aspettano compiti e questioni varie in un ambiente dinamico e stimolante. Sarai principalmente responsabile dell'esecuzione delle analisi di rilascio dei nostri principi attivi TIDES secondo GMP.

Le tue mansioni

- Esecuzione autonoma, valutazione e documentazione delle analisi di rilascio nell'ambito della gascromatografia (GC) e della cromatografia ionica (IC)
- Revisione e approvazione delle analisi di rilascio
- Sviluppo, validazione e gestione del ciclo di vita dei metodi di analisi GC e IC
- Redazione e revisione di documenti GMP (ad es. istruzioni di analisi, SOP)
- Assunzione di responsabilità nell'ambiente di laboratorio (inclusa la pianificazione dell'analisi di routine, troubleshooting)
- Gestione dei dati master / registrazioni nel LIMS
- Supporto nella qualificazione degli strumenti e dei sistemi analitici secondo le linee guida GMP vigenti e gestione del ciclo di vita degli strumenti analitici
- Partecipazione attiva a misure di ottimizzazione e miglioramento dei processi QC

Il tuo profilo

- Formazione professionale completata come tecnico di laboratorio chimico, indirizzo analitica
- Pluriennale esperienza professionale nell'ambito dell'analisi cromatografica GMP
- Conoscenze nel campo GC/GCMS e IC sono un vantaggio
- Solide conoscenze delle applicazioni IT comuni, ad es. LIMS/LES, CDS (ad es. Chromeleon), SAP, nonché affinità con il software
- Buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese parlato e scritto
- Persona affidabile con entusiasmo per la responsabilità e l'iniziativa
- Metodo di lavoro preciso, orientato alla qualità e al servizio

en.title: Lab Technician QC - Late Phase 100% (a) fixed-term 12 months
en.description:
Description

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals.

To strengthen our GC/IC team in the QC Late Phase department, we are seeking an experienced Lab Technician for GC/IC analytics (fixed-term 12 months).

As a committed and motivated individual, you will be part of our demanding release analytics. You can expect diverse tasks and challenges in a dynamic and exciting environment. Your main responsibility will be the execution of release analyses of our TIDES active ingredients under GMP.

Your Tasks

- Independent execution, evaluation, and documentation of release analyses in the field of gas chromatography (GC) and ion chromatography (IC)
- Review and approval of release analyses
- Development, validation, and life cycle management of GC and IC analytical methods
- Creation and revision of GMP documents (e.g., analytical instructions, SOPs)
- Taking on responsibilities in the laboratory environment (including planning routine analytics, troubleshooting)
- Maintenance of master data / logbook entries in LIMS
- Support in analytical instrument and system qualification according to applicable GMP guidelines and life cycle management of analytical devices
- Active participation in measures to optimize and improve QC processes

Your Profile

- Completed vocational training as a chemical laboratory technician, specialization in analytics
- Several years of professional experience in chromatographic GMP analytics
- Knowledge in GC/GCMS and IC is an advantage
- Solid knowledge of common IT applications, e.g., LIMS/LES, CDS (e.g., Chromeleon), SAP, as well as software affinity
- Good German and English skills, both spoken and written
- Reliable personality with enthusiasm for responsibility and initiative
- Quality-conscious, precise, and service-oriented working style
- Openness to innovations and changes

Our Offer

- A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development opportunities
- Employee support through numerous internal and external training offers
- 60% coverage of pension fund contributions by Bachem AG and the possibility for additional pension provision with our optional savings plan
- Access to the Swibeco benefits platform with discounts at external partners
- Fresh, healthy, and varied food in our staff restaurant
- Diverse free sports activities on the Bachem campus

Have we sparked your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal.

Learn more about the Bachem Group and be inspired by our motivating work environment at our Bubendorf location!

fr.description:
Description

Pour soutenir notre croissance organique continue, nous recherchons constamment des professionnels hautement qualifiés.

Pour renforcer notre équipe GC/IC au sein du département QC Phase Tardive, nous recherchons un technicien de laboratoire expérimenté pour l'analyse GC/IC (CDD de 12 mois).

En tant que personne engagée et motivée, vous ferez partie de notre analyse de libération exigeante. Vous aurez des tâches variées et des problématiques dans un environnement dynamique et passionnant. Vous serez principalement responsable de la réalisation des analyses de libération de nos principes actifs TIDES selon les normes GMP.

Vos tâches

- Réalisation autonome, évaluation et documentation des analyses de libération dans le domaine de la chromatographie en phase gazeuse (GC) et de la chromatographie ionique (IC)
- Revue et validation des analyses de libération
- Développement, validation et gestion du cycle de vie des méthodes analytiques GC et IC
- Rédaction et révision de documents GMP (par ex. instructions d'analyse, SOP)
- Prise de responsabilités dans l'environnement du laboratoire (notamment planification des analyses de routine, résolution de problèmes)
- Gestion des données de base / entrées dans le registre dans LIMS
- Soutien à la qualification des instruments et systèmes analytiques selon les directives GMP en vigueur et gestion du cycle de vie des appareils analytiques
- Participation active aux mesures d'optimisation et d'amélioration des processus QC

Votre profil

- Formation professionnelle achevée en tant que technicien de laboratoire en chimie, spécialisation analytique
- Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle en analyse chromatographique GMP
- Connaissances en GC/GCMS et IC appréciées
- Bonne maîtrise des applications informatiques courantes, par ex. LIMS/LES, CDS (par ex. Chromeleon), SAP, ainsi qu'une affinité pour les logiciels
- Bonne maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais, à l'oral et à l'écrit
- Personnalité fiable avec enthousiasme pour la responsabilité et l'initiative

- Ouverture à l'innovation et au changement
